activities.title: Oral Language Development: Community Circle Time
activities.content:
Greeting
• Welcome pupils and have them sit in a circle. 
• Say: Nu tàmbali bés bi ak nuyoo. Nanu nuyoo ak sunu loxo ndeyjoor. Na ku nekka ékati loxo     
            ndeyjooram.
• Check to make sure every pupil is holding up the right hand.
• Say: Saa yoo dajee ak nit, jakkaarlool ak moom, nuyu ko te céral ko.
• Turn to the pupil on your right, shake their hand.
• Say: Jàmma ngeen fanaan, (oo turi xale bi).
• Pupil should respond back saying "Good morning, teacher."
• Have the pupil that was just greeted, turn to the pupil on their right and greet them. This    
 continues all the way around the circle.
Theme Discussion
• Before school starts, bring in two items related to the theme to show the pupils. Put the    
 items in the center of the circle. If no items are available, draw two pictures on the board    
 instead.
• Say:  Sunu waaru bés bu ay bi moo di 'Ngédda.' Misaal yi ci pàcci bii yéppa méngoo ak waar wi.
• Hold up one of the items from the center of the circle. 
• Say: "Lii lan la?"
• Call on a pupil at random to answer.
• Say: Ban jokkoo la am ak Ngédda li?
• Call on 2-3 pupils at random to answer. Repeat with the second item.
• Say: Lan moo méngale mbir yii ak ngédda? 
• Give pupils one minute to think, even close their eyes to picture their response. Then      
 choose one of the following options for discussion: call on pupils at random, Turn and Talk    

      (have pupils turn to a pupil next to them), go around the circle and allow every pupil to answer        
 (only if the answer is short), or have pupils take turns acting out answers.
• Encourage pupils to bring in their own items relating to the theme throughout the week.
Activity
•  Play: "If you are happy and you know it…" (Insert a song/rhyme)
Sooleen bégge te xam ko tàcculeen, 
Sooleen bégge te xam ko tàcculeen, 
Sooleen bégge te xam ko

tàcculeen

activities.title: Learning Sounds
activities.content:
Identify Sounds: What Sound Am I Maing?
• Say: Dina nu wóy ab wóy wu méngoo ak nu nu war a binde benna benna. Lii dina nu dimbale nu 
mën a jànga sunu araf yi.
• Pupils close their eyes. Make a sound (example: tap desk with pencil, close the door, slide 
chair across floor, drop a book on the table). Then call on a pupil at random to describe 
the sound and guess what was used to make the sound. Call on another pupil if first was   
incorrect. Continue with another sound.

activities.title: Alphabet
activities.content:
Alphabet Song
• Say: Dina nu wóy ab wóy wu méngoo ak nu nu war a binde benna benna. Lii dina nu dimbale nu
• mën a jànga sunu araf yi. 
• Teach the alphabet song/chant: ( a à b c d e é ë    f h g I j k l    m n ñ ŋ o ó p    q r s t u w x y)

activities.title: Letter of the Week
activities.content:
Learning Letter: "a A" 
• Write the small letter "a" very big on the board. Point to the letter.
• Say:  Dina nu wóy wóyu abcd bi wu nuy dimbale ci ni nu war a toppalantee sunu araf yi benna 
benna. Lii dina nu dimbale nu mën a jànga sunu araf yi.
• Point to the letter on the board or letter card, say the sound, have pupils repeat 3 times   
slowly.
• Write the capital letter "A" very big on the board. Point to the capital letter.
• Say: Lii benna araf bi la. Moom itam riiru /A/ la. Gis nanu ne dina nu ko jéfoo sunoo binda ci 
tàmbali kàddu, turi nit walla béréb.
• Point to the letter on the board or letter card, say the sound, have pupils repeat 3 times 
slowly.
• Point to the small letter "a" on the board or letter card again.

• Say: Li ci gën a bari nii lanu koo gise ci baat yi.

activities.title: Writing
activities.content:
Fine Motor Development
• Say:. Dina nu tàggat sunu sadditi loxo yi ak yaram. Lii dina nu dimbale nu mën a binda bu 
baax. Ni sunu sadditi loxo yi gën a dégéreee, ci laa gën a yomba nu mën a jéfoo sunu loxo yi 
sunoo binda.
• Exercise is marching: standing in place the opposite arm swings forward to the raised knee 
(left arm and right knee together). As pupils march on the spot, give orders: low march knees 
raised slightly), normal march (knees raised to half raised), high march (knees raised as high 
as possible), left turn, right turn, face forward.
• Alternative exercise is the crab walk: (make sure the ground is not dirty so pupils do not soil 
their clothes) sit on the ground with legs extended out in front, place hands by side with 
fingers pointed toward feet, lift body up into the air, start moving forward or backwards. 
Have pupils try for one minute then have them stop and rest for a minute.    
• Then have them try again for another minute.

lessons.homework: Ask learners to teach their family members the letter name and sound they learnt today.

activities.title: Vocabulary
activities.content:
Teach and Discuss New Words
• Words:
   golo       banaana  
• Say: Nanu jànga baat yu bees yi, mu dimbale nu, nu xam léeb bi bu baax. Am na baat yu fés yu  
nu war a jànga ci léeb bi.
• Say the first vocabulary word, but do not write it on the board. Then have pupils say the word 
aloud. Repeat two more times.
• Ask pupils what they know about the word. Share the meaning of the word, using gestures or 
illustrations to support understanding. 
• If needed, help pupils understand the word by saying it in another language.
• Repeat all steps with remaining word.

activities.title: Before Reading & Reason to Read
activities.content:
Learn New Print Concepts
• Think about how we read a book. Show the cover.
• Say: Su noo jànga danoo dale ci kow wàcca ci suuf (joxoñal ak sa baaraam) jóge càmmoñ dem 
ndeyjoor (joxoñal ak sa baaraam) turi téere bi. Danuy ólbati kéyit gi jóge ci kanam dem ci 
ganaaw. 
• Have pupils follow the motions as you show on the book TOP to BOTTOM and RIGHT to LEFT 
and turn pages FRONT to BACK.

activities.title: Comprehension
activities.content:
Making Predictions: Picture Walk 
• Say: "Sunu xoole nataal yi méngoo ak léeb bi, dina nu dimbale nu xelaat naka la léeb bi di deme. 
Lii moo njorta li war a xew. Yenna saayi njorta mën na nekka mën na ñakka, waay nu mu deme 
rek, am na njériñ. Jàngakat bu baax war naa mën a njorta lan moo war a xew ci léeb."  
• Read the title of the story. Look at the illustration.
• Say: "Gis naa benna xale bu góor ak cabi banaana ci kow garabi banaana ci nataal bii. Foog naa 
ne léeb bi mbiri xale bu góor la ku bëgga lekka banaana. Dama xelaat lii ndax xale bu góor bi mu 
ngee xool cabi banaana yi te di xelaat nakka la koo sàkkee. 
• Continue through the book. Stop at each picture but do not read the story. 
• "Lan nga foog ne moo xew soo xoole nataal bi?"
• Give pupils less than a minute to look, then call on a pupil at random asking for their prediction. 
Then call on another pupil at random asking for their prediction. If pupils are having difficulty 
making a prediction, share one of your own.
Vocabulary Review
• On the pages that have a vocabulary word, stop and draw pupil attention to the word.
• Say: "Fan lanu gis sunu baat bu fés bi'banaana' ci nataal bi?"
• Call on a pupil at random. Affirm the correct answer or attempt, let them know if it is correct, 
and clarify the answer. If pupils have trouble finding the word in the picture, remind them of 
the meaning of the word.

lessons.homework: Ask learners to teach their family members the new vocabulary words they learnt today.

activities.title: Learning Sounds
activities.content:
Song to Count Words
• Teach a song or rhyme: 
Benna ñaar laalal sa bakan
Ñette ñenent tàccuIeen
Juróom juróom benna rippil sa tànka
Juóom ñaar, juróom ñetta dajale sa óom
Juróom ñenent fukka wengal baat. 
• Sing 1-2 times.
• Say: Danoo  wóyaat wóyu abcd wi, waay bii yoon danu koo wóyee neneen. Baat bu nu wax rek, 
nu rippi sunu tànka yi. Dégluleen bu baax ma won leen defin wu bees wi noo wóyee wóy wi di 
rippiwaale sunu tànka. 
• Demonstrate singing and stepping for each word. Then lead pupils in doing the same. Sing 1-2 
 more times while stepping for each word.
• Other options: Clap or jump for each word.

activities.title: Alphabet
activities.content:
Name Card #1
• Before the lesson, create two name cards for each pupil with their first name.
• Give each pupil their name card and you keep the other set. 
• Say: Na ku nekka toog fi mu toog. Seetleen tur bi nu binda ci karta bi. Dinaa ékati benna tur ci 
kow, na ku nekka seet ndax méngoo na ak sa bos. Su nekkee sa tur, ñówal ci man. Su nekkul sa 
tur, toogal fi nga nekka. 
• Hold up a name card and walk around so every pupil can see the name. Once there is a   

match, continue with another name. Do as many names as possible in time allotted.
• If pupils are having difficulties, say the name written on the card.

activities.title: Letter of the Week
activities.content:
Learning Letter: "a" 
• Write the small letter "a" very big on the board. Point to the letter.
• Say: "Araf bii moo di sunu arafu bés bu ay bi. Riiru araf bii moo /a/. Accaleen nu waxandoor ko 
/a/."
• Hold up the letter card. 
•  Say "Arafu /a/ moo ñów ci tàmbali baatu 'almoor' /a/ mungi jóge ci baatu 'almoor"
• Have pupils repeat: " almoor," /a/

activities.title: Writing
activities.content:
Fine Motor Development
• Say: "Dina nu  tàggat sunu sadditi loxo yi ak yu yaram yi. Lii dina nu dimbale nu mën a binda 
bu baax. Ni sunu sadditi loxo yi gën a dégéree, ci laa gën a yomba nu mën a jéfoo sunu loxo yi 
sunoo binda."
• Exercise is cross crawling: stand up straight, take one elbow and touch it to the knee on the 
opposite side (raise knee and lower elbow at the same time to meet in the middle); then take 
the other elbow and touch it to the opposite knee.
• Have pupils try for one minute then have them stop and rest for a minute. Then have     
them try again for another minute. 
• If pupils are having difficulty, have them touch one hand to the opposite knee

activities.title: Comprehension: Before Reading
activities.content:
Making Predictions: Picture Walk
• Say: Mën na noo xool nataal bi, jéfooleen te seet ni léeb bi di mujje. Lii moo di nga leeral lan 
• moo war a xew walla nga xelaat ci li nga njorta.
• Read the title of the story. Look at the illustration. Remind the pupils of their predictions. 
• Say: "Léegi, da noo jànga léeb bi, xool ndax sunu njorta yi jub na."

activities.title: Comprehension: During Reading
activities.content:
Read Aloud
• Before reading each page, look at the illustration and remind the class what they predicted. 
Then read the page. 
• Say: 'Léegi, ndax sunu njorta yi jub na?'
• Provide feedback. Continue through the story.
Golo gi ak banaana bi
Dafa amoon benna xale bu am juróomi at bu tuddoon Karim. Benna bés Karim dem ci tool bi gis fa 
banaana ak màngoro. Karim xiif be waay jotul banaana bi jotul màngoro bi, banaana bi ak
màngoro bi danu kowe lool. Mu toog rek gis benna golo bu ndaw ci saasi mu xool ko muuñ, golo gu 
ndaw gi dog banaana jox Karim, mu ne ko jéréjéf golo. Golo dogaat màngoro joxaat ko Karim mu 
ne ko waat jéréjéf.
Ci diir bu gatta mu gis meññeef ci ab ndab, waay ndab li ci biir waañ wi la nekka. Golo mënula 
dugga ci waañ wi. Léegi nag Karim tég baaraamam bi ci tuñam yi ne ko: "Noppil" "Muut" ssss
Karim daw gaaw dem ca waañ wa jél fa soraas ci ndab la jox ko golo gu ndaw gi ci biti. Golo gi 
bég, lekka soraas bi be mu jeex ne ko; "Jéréjéf." Karim xool màngoro ji xoolaat banaana bi xoolaat 
màngoro ji bëggaat xaritam ñówat ci saasi. Waay bii yoon golo ñówaatul.

activities.title: Comprehension: After Reading
activities.content:
Prediction Check
• Say: Jànga nanu ni noo jëfoo sunu xelaat yi di njorta nu léeb bi di mujje. Nekkul ne saayu 
nekka mu jub waay jàngakat bu baax du xàddi.

activities.title: Vocabulary: After Reading
activities.content:
Vocabulary Check
• Say: Kan moo dégga baat bu fés bi ci léeb bi.
• Call on a pupil at random to tell the word they heard. If they did or did not, turn to the page 
with the vocabulary word.Tell pupils to put their hands on their head when they hear the 
vocabulary word. 
• Read the sentence with the word. Point to the word and say it out loud. Have pupils repeat the 
word. Say the definition. 
• Repeat with the next vocabulary word.

lessons.homework: Ask learners to tell their family members about the story that was read in class today.

• Say: Jàmma ngeen fanaan (oo turi xale bi).
• Pupil should respond back saying "Good morning, teacher."
• Have the pupil that was just greeted, turn to the pupil on their right and greet them. This  
continues all the way around the circle.
Theme Discussion

items in the center of the circle. If no items are available, draw two pictures on the     
board instead.
• Say: Bés bu ay bii sunu jubluwaay moo di 'Suma Màggal yi.' misaal yi ci taabul bi méngoo na ak 
waar wi.
• Hold up one of the items from the center of the circle. a
• Say: "Lii lan la?"
• Call on a pupil at random to answer.
• Say: Lan nga ma mën a wax ci lii? 
• Call on 2-3 pupils at random to answer. Repeat with the second item.

• Say: Yan nuyoo lanu dee gën di jéfoo ci bés bu noo màggal bés bi réew mi moome boppam?
• Give pupils one minute to think, even close their eyes to picture their response. Then     
choose one of the following options for discussion: call on pupils at random, Turn and Talk  
 (have pupils turn to a pupil next to them), go around the circle and allow every pupil to 
answer (only if the answer is short), or have pupils take turns acting out answers.

      Wax ma lu laa yéggal daal, a dinama yéngal daal.

activities.title: Alphabet
activities.content:
Name Card #1
• Before the lesson, create two name cards for each pupil with their first name.
• Give each pupil their name card and you keep the other set. 

• Say: Na ku nekka toog fi mu toog. Seetleen tur bi nu binda ci karta bi. Dinaa ékati benna 
• tur ci kow, na ku nekka seet ndax méngoo na ak sa bos. Su nekkee sa tur, ñówal ci man. Su 
nekkul sa tur, toogal fi nga nekka.
• Hold up a name card and walk around so every pupil can see the name. Once       
there is a match, continue with another name. Do as many names as possible       
in time allotted.
• If pupils are having difficulties, say the name written on the card.
4.Letter of the Week (2 mins)
 Learning Letter: "b B" 
Write the small letter "b" very big on the board. Point to the letter.
• Say: Lii moo di mbindam bés bu ay bi. Bii moo di mbindam rafta /b/. Accaleen nu waxandoor 
ko /b/.
• Hold up the letter card.
• Say: Bii moo arafu /b/ bi jóge ci baatu 'bale'. /b/ bi mungi ci doorini baat bi. 
• Have pupils repeat: "bale" /b/.

activities.content:
Fine Motor Development
• Say: Lii moo di mbindam bés bu ay bi. Bii moo mbindam rafta /b/. Accaleen nu waxandoor ko 
/b/.  
• Exercise is marching standing in place the opposite arm swings forward to the raised knee 
(left arm and right knee together). As pupils march on the spot, give orders: low march 
(knbees raised slightly), normal march (knbees raised to half raised), high march (knbees

• Alternative exercise is the crab walk: (make sure the ground is not dirty so pupils do not soil

fingers pointed toward feet, lift body up into the air, start moving forward or backwards. 
Have pupils try for one minute then have them stop and rest for a minute.    
• Then have them try again for another minute.

activities.content:

• Before reading each page, look at the illustration and remind the class what they predicted. 
Then read the page. 
• Say: Ndax li nu foogoon am na?
• Provide feedback. Continue through the story.
Baykat bi ak mbaam mi
Dafa amoon benna baykat bu dëkka Pakau. Bés bu nekka, suba teel mu dem ci toolam. Su àggee 
dafa dee liggéey bu baax dina dog gaji yi te ruuj tool bi ba mu set mu jémbat fa ñambi. Nambi ji 
jebbi, naat be. Mu di ko bay be mu ñor. Saayu mu jóge ci tool bi, dina indiwaale ñambi ci kër gi.
Baykat bi ku tabe la, mu mey ku nekka. Mu sédda buur bi ak lingeeram bi.
Benna bés buur bi ne; "Nanu tànna benna bés ngir xew, ku nekka na indi ci lu mu ñorle. Baykat bi 
ne ko; "baax na dinaa indi ñambi. Bi moo dem ci toolam bi mu tase ak mbaam. Mbaam nuyu ko ne 
ko "Jàmma nga fanaan" baykat bi ne ko; "Jàmma rek."
Mbaam ne ko" "Ndax mën nga maa dimbale ci kéwél, mu ngee lekka suma tool bi rek". Baykat bi 
ne ko; "Su fekkee ne dinga ma dimbale, dinaa la dimbale." Mbaam nangu. Baykat bi war mbaam 
nuy daqa kéwél. Kéwél di daw di cirib ciribi ci tool bi be récca. kéwél a gën a gaaw mbaam waay 
baykat bi ne ko; Am naa beneen pexe," mu uti sabar kéwél ñemewut téggi sabar mu daw ndax 
raggal sabar, Bés bóobu betey kéwél ñówatul di lekka ci tooli mbaam mi.
Mbaam ne baykat bi, Dinaa la dimbale, ebal la ñambi yi yóobu ko si kër buur. Ña ñ nekkoon kër 
buur ñép bég. Buur ne mbaam, "Nun ñéppa bég nanu ci yow," "Danu bëgga nga dëkka ak nun su la 
neexe," ñu ñaan ko, mbaam mi nangu. Bés bóobu betey ci la mbaam mi dékka kër buur di dimbale 
nit ñi.

• Say: Jàmma nga fanaan, (oo turi xale bi).

Theme Discussion

• Exercise is cross crawling: stand up straight, take one elbow and touch it to the knee on the 
opposite side (raise knee and lower elbow at the same time to meet in the middle); then take

• If pupils are having difficulty, have them touch one hand to the opposite knee.

Kër ak nit yu uute  
Ca dékki kow ya la Mariyaama dëkka, ca néegi ban bu nu xéddee ñax la dëkka. Mariyaama ku 
bëgga këram la. Benna bés, nijaayam ñów seet si ko jóge ca dékki taax ya. Mariyaama laaj ko; 
"Naka la seen kër mel?" Nijaayam tontu ko ne; "Mangi dèkka ci taax bu gudda ak suma njaboot." 
Suma kër am na tabax yu dégér, néeg yi am palanteer yu am weer. Kër gu réy lanu bokka." Kali 
Mariyaa bi, Faatu moom ci wetu dex gi la dëkka. Mariyaama dem fa seeti ko. Këri Faatu moom 
néegu tóoj bu kirinting la, mungi dëkka ca kow.
Mariyaama laaj ko, "Lan moo tax sa néeg bi kowe?" Faatu ne ko, "Su dex gi fbeesee walla moo 
taw, ndox mi du mën a éeg ci kow, su ko defe néeg bi du yol, du tooy te dina am na kaarange." 
Mariyaama dem seeti xaritam ba Lamin. Lamin moom ci mbaar la dëkka ndax ay mbokkam  
sàmmakat lanu, danu dee toxu lu bari ak seen jur gi. Fu am ñax rek nu dem fa ngir seen jur gi am 
lekka. Laamin tegal ko ci ne,"Nun sunoo toxu danu dee yóbbuwaale sunu mbaar mi." Mariyaama 
xelaat ne néeg yi yép ak dékkuwaay yi yép a uute te xam ne ku nekka am na kër gu uute ak  
moroma. Mariyaama ne, "Ku nekka am kër waay yép a uute te ku nekka ngi dëkka ak njambootam 
ci kaarange ak teranga.

binda.
• Exercise is marching standing in place the opposite arm swings forward to the raised knee 
(left arm and right knee together). As pupils march on the spot, give orders: low march 
(knbees raised slightly), normal march (knbees raised to half raised), high march (knbees 
raised as high as possible), left turn, right turn, face forward.
• Alternative exercise is the crab walk: (make sure the ground is not dirty, so pupils do not 
soil their clothes) sit on the ground with legs extended out in front, place hands by side with 
fingers pointed toward feet, lift body up into the air, start moving forward or backwards. 
Have pupils try for one minute then have them stop and rest for a minute. Then have them try 
again for another minute.

Baaxoñ bu mar
Dafa amoon benna baaxoñ bu muus. Benna bés ci noor mu tànga lool, baaxoñ mar lool bëgga naan 
te amut ndox. Mu ne xaaral ma xaar be nawet, bu tawee ma naan. Mu toog di xaar lu yàgga lool 
waay tawut. Baaxoñ gën a mar, ngalaw li wow, naaj wi tànga, asamaan si xiinul. Baaxoñ dogu ne 
"Damaa uti ndox mu ma naan balaa maa dee.' Mu tàmbali di naaw di wór ci àlla bi, di naaw ci doj 
yi ak xur yi waay amul benna ndox mu mu naan. Moo yurndu ci ron gajji yi gisul dara, mu naaw be 
ci ron benna garab rek, mu gis fa lu doy waar. Benna ndaal lu am ndox mu tuuti. 
Baaxoñ jotul ndox mi, mënula naan. Mu ne: "Man naka laa war a def be naan ci ndox mii ci ndaal 
li?" Baaxoñ di tób di wór ndaal li wet gu ne jotul ndox mi. Mu békka ndaal li ngir ndox mi tuuru 
mu naan te amul kàttan waay xàddiwul, bayyiwul. Mu for doj yu sew te bari di leen sanni ci biir 
ndaal li benna benna corox, corox, corox, ndox mi di éeg tuuti tuuti be egsi ci kow ndaal li. Baaxoñ 
taxaw ci kéméju ndaal li, di naan, di naan, di naan be mandi. Mu bég ci boppam lool. Baaxoñ 
mënula wòy waay mën naa lapi lapi di dem doxi yeneen soxlaam.

their head when a vocabulary word is said. At each vocabulary word, stop and review its meaning

Kër ak nit yu uute 
Ca dékki kow ya la Mariyaama dëkka, ca néegi ban bu nu xéddée ñax la dëkka. Mariyaama ku 
bëgga këram la. Benna bés, nijaayam ñów seet si ko jóge ca dékki taax ya. Mariyaama laaj ko; 
"Naka la seen kër mel?" Nijaayam tontu ko ne; "Mangi dèkka ci taax bu gudda ak suma njaboot." 
Suma kër am na tabax yu dégér, néeg yi am palanteer yu am weer. Kër gu réy lanu bokka." Kali 
Mariyaa bi, Faatu moom ci wetu dex gi la dëkka. Mariyaama dem fa seeti ko. Këri Faatu moom 
néegu tóoj bu kirinting la, mu ngi dëkka ca kow.
Mariyaama laaj ko, "Lan moo tax sa néeg bi kowe?" Faatu ne ko, "Su dex gi fbeesee walla mu di 
taw, ndox mi du mën a éeg ci kow, su ko defee néeg bi du yol, du tooy te dina am na kaarange."
Mariyaama dem seeti xaritam ba Lamin. Lamin moom ci mbaar la dëkka ndax ay mbokkam 
sàmmakat lanu, danu dee toxu lu bari ak seen jur gi. Fu am ñax rek nu dem fa ngir seen jur gi am 
lekka. Laamin tegal ko ci ne, "nun sunoo toxu danu dee yóbbuwaale sunu mbaar mi." Mariyaama 
xelaat ne néeg yi yép ak dékkuwaay yi yép a uute te xam ne ku nekka am na kër gu uute ak 
moroma. Mariyaama ne, "Ku nekka am kër waay yép a uute te ku nekka ngi dëkka ak njambootam 
ci kaarange ak teranga.

Learning Letter: "e"
• Write the small letter "e" very big on the board. Point to the letter.
• Say: Lii moo sunu arafi bés bu ay bi. Riiru araf bii moo /e/. Accaleen nu waxandoor ko /e/
• Point to the letter on the board or letter card, say the sound, have pupils repeat 3 times 
slowly.
• Write the capital letter "E e" very big on the board. Point to the capital letter.
• Say: Lii benna araf bi la. Moom itam riiru /E/ la. Dina nuko jéfoo sunoo binda ci tàmbali kàddu, 
turi nit walla béréb.
• Point to the letter on the board or letter card, say the sound, have pupils repeat 3 times 
slowly.
• Point to the small letter "e" on the board or letter card again.
• Say: Li ci gën a bari nii lanu koo gise ci baat yi.

activities.title: Writing
activities.content:
Fine Motor Development
• Say: Dina nu  tàggat sunu sadditi loxo yi ak yu yaram yi. Lii dina nu dimbale nu mën a binda 
bu baax. Ni sunu sadditi loxo yi gën a dégéree ci la noo  gën a mën a jéfoo sunu loxo yi su noo 
binda.   
• Exercise is marching- standing in place the opposite arm swings forward to the raised knee 
(left arm and right knee together). As pupils march on the spot, give orders: low march 
(knbees raised slightly), normal march (knbees raised to half raised), high march (knbees 
raised as high as possible), left turn, right turn, face forward.
• Alternative exercise is the crab walk: (make sure the ground is not dirty, so pupils do not 
soil their clothes) sit on the ground with legs extended out in front, place hands by side with 
fingers pointed toward feet, lift body up into the air, start moving forward or backwards. 
Have pupils try for one minute then have them stop and rest for a minute. Then have them try 
again for another minute.

• Say: Sunu xoole nataal yi méngoo ak léeb bi,dina nu dimbale nu xelaat naka la léeb bi di deme. 
Lii moo di njorta lu war a xew. Yenna saayi njorta mën na jub walla mu ñakka jub, waay nu mu 
deme rek am na njériñ. Jàngakat bu baax war naa mën a njorta liy ñów ci léeb bi. Jàngal boppi 
léeb bi. Xoolal nataal bi. 
• Read the title of the story. Look at the illustration.
• Say: Gis naa ay néeg yu uute ci nataal bi. Foog naa ne, léeb bi mbiri dékkuwaayi nit ñi la.

• Say: Soo xoole  nataal bi ci mbiri léeb bi, lan ngeen foog ne moo war a xew?
• Give pupils less than a minute to look, then call on a pupil at random asking for their prediction. 
Then call on another pupil at random asking for their prediction. If pupils are having difficulty 
making a prediction, share one of your own.
Vocabulary Review
• On the pages that have a vocabulary word, stop and draw pupil attention to the word.
• Say: Ci nataal bi, fan lanu gis sunu baat bu fés bi 'kër.'
• Call on a pupil at random. Affirm the correct answer or attempt, let them know if it is correct, 
and clarify the answer. If pupils have trouble finding the word in the picture, remind them of 
the meaning of the word.

Bésu Omar Bu Njékka Ca Jànguwaay Ba
Omar teel a eewu, tey moo bés bu moo tàmbali njànga. Mu ne: "Tey sawar naa lool waay dama 
xawa tiit. Yaayam dimbale ko mu solu be jag. Yaayam ne ko: "Yangi rafet lool." Bi nu demee ca 
jànguwaay ba, Omar gis fa xale yu bari, ñii nungee fo, ñii di jooy, ñenna ñi raggal. Omar xawa tiit 
mu ne yaayam: "Damaa ñibbi ca kër ga."
Benna jigèen bu rafet ñów, ne: "Man jàngalekat laa, Mariyaama laa tudda, naka nga def? 
Mariyaama muuñ ne Omar "Yow yaay Omar? kaay seet kalaas bi. Mu won ko ay téere ak ay 
foyeekaay, mu won ko fi noo léebée ak fu noo foyee.
Omar gis fa benna xale bu tudda Saaliw. Mu ne Omar: "Man itam dama tiitoon, waay jànguwaay bi 
neex na te bari foyeekaay. Ñu léebal leen léeb yu neex ci rab yi. Ñu wóy fa wóyu wañi yu neex. Ñu 
lekkandoor fa suusal. Omar am na xarit te jànga na lu bees.
 
Bi Yaayam ñówée jèl si ko mu fekka Omar di muuñ. Mu laaj ko: "Naka la jànguwaay bi melon tey? 
Omar tontu ko ne: "Neex na lool, damaa dellusi élég. Ca guddi ga mu wax baayam naka la bésam 
bu njékka ci jànguwaay ba neexe.

activities.title: Oral Language Development: Community Circle Time
activities.content:
Greeting
• Welcome pupils and have them sit in a circle. 
• Say: Nu tàmbali bés bi ak nuyoo. Nanu nuyoo ak sunu loxo ndeyjoor. Na ku nekka ékati loxo 
ndeyjooram. 
• Check to make sure every pupil is holding up the right hand.
• Say: Saa yoo dajee ak nit, jakkaarlool ak moom, nuyu ko te céral ko.
• Turn to the pupil on your right, shake their hand.
•  Say: Jàmma ngeen fanaan, (oo turi xale bi).
• Pupil should respond back saying "Good morning, teacher."
• Have the pupil that was just greeted, turn to the pupil on their right and greet them. This 
continues all the way around the circle. 
Theme Discussion 
• Before school starts, bring in two items related to the theme to show the pupils. Put the items 
in the center of the circle. If no items are available, draw two pictures on the board instead.
• Say: Say: Sunu waaru bés bu ay bii moo 'Suma Jànguwaay'' misaal yi nekka ci xët mi méngoo 
na ak waar wi.
• Hold up one of the items from the center of the circle. 
• Say: Lii lan la?
• Call on a pupil at random to answer.
• Say: Ci naka ngeen ma mën a leeralalee lii?
• Call on 2-3 pupils at random to answer. Repeat with the second item.
• Say: Sa xarit su tarxiise walla mu daanu, ci naka ngeen ko mën a dimbalee?
• Give pupils one minute to think, even close their eyes to picture their response. Then choose 
one of the following options for discussion: call on pupils at random, Turn and Talk (have 
pupils turn to a pupil next to them), go around the circle and allow every pupil to answer (only 
if the answer is short), or have pupils take turns acting out answers.

• Encourage pupils to bring in their own items relating to the theme throughout the week.

• Play: Song/Rhyme
Xaritoo jàmma ca gën nanu dem jàngi

Xaritoo jàmma ca gën; nanu dem jàngi 
Bunuxaritoo te dem jàngi, jériñ sunu réew

activities.title: Learning Sounds
activities.content:
Identify Sounds: What Sound Am I Making?
• Say:  Dinaa def ab yéngu. Gómmaleen te wax ma li ma jéfoo be def yéngu bi.
• Pupils close their eyes. Make a sound (example: tap desk with pencil, close the door, slide 
chair. 
• across floor, drop a book on the table). Then call on a pupil at random to describe the sound 
and guess what was used to make the sound. Call on another pupil if first was incorrect.
• Continue with another sound.

activities.title: Alphabet
activities.content:
Alphabet Song
• Say: Nanu wóy wóyu abcd bi (walla wax ay baat) jànge ci ni noo binde ay araf. Lii dina nu 
dimbale nu gën a mën a fàttaleku sunu araf yi.
• Sing the alphabet song/chant: /a, b, d/  ( a à  b c d e é ë  f h g I j k l  m n ñ ŋ o ó p  q r s t u w x 
y)

activities.title: Letter of the Week
activities.content:
Learning Letter "e"
• Write the small letter "e" very big on the board. Point to the letter.
• Say: Lii moo sunu riiru bés bu ay bi. Riiru araf bii moo /e/. Accaleen nu waxandoor  ko /e/.
• Point to the letter on the board or letter card, say the sound, have pupils repeat 3 times 
slowly.
• Write the capital letter "E" very big on the board. Point to the capital letter.
• Say: Lii benna araf bi la. Moom itam riiru /E/ la. Dina nuko jéfoo sunoo binda ci tàmbali kàddu, 
turi nit walla béréb
• Point to the letter on the board or letter card, say the sound, have pupils repeat 3 times 
slowly.
• Point to the small letter "e" on the board or letter card again.
• Say: Li ci gën a bari nii lanu koo gise  ci baat yi.

activities.title: Writing
activities.content:
Fine Motor Development
• Say: Dina nu tàggat sunu sadditi loxo yi ak yaram yi. Lii dina nu dimbale nu mën a binda bu 
baax. Ni sunu sadditi loxo yi gën a dégéree ci la nu gën a mën a jéfoo sunu loxo yi su noo 
binda.   
• Exercise is marching: standing in place the opposite arm swings forward to the raised knee 
(left arm and right knee together). As pupils march on the spot, give orders: low march (knees 
raised slightly), normal march (knees raised to half raised), high march (knees raised as high 
as possible), left turn, right turn, face forward.
• Alternative exercise is the crab walk: (make sure the ground is not dirty so pupils do not soil 
their clothes) sit on the ground with legs extended out in front, place hands by side with 
fingers pointed toward feet, lift body up into the air, start moving forward or backwards. Have 
pupils try for one minute then have them stop and rest for a minute. Then have them try again 
for another minute.
• Have pupils follow the motions as you show on the book TOP to BOTTOM and RIGHT to LEFT 
and turn pages FRONT to BACK.

lessons.homework:
• Give each pupil a letter card and ask them to practice saying the letter name and sound with 
their family members.
• Ask learners to identify an object from their homes that starts with the letter sound of the day 
and report to class the next day.

ganaaw.
• Have pupils follow the motions as you show on the book TOP to BOTTOM and RIGHT to LEFT

activities.title: Comprehension
activities.content:
Making Predictions: Picture Walk (Big Book- if available)
• Say:  Sunu xoole nataal yi méngoo ak léeb bi, dina nu dimbale nu xelaat naka la léeb bi di deme. 
Lii moo di njorta li war a xew. Yenna saayi njorta mën na jub walla mu ñakka jub, waay nu mu 
deme rek am na njériñ. Jàngakat bu baax war naa mën a njorta liy ñów ci léeb bi. Jàngal boppi 
léeb bi. Xoolal nataal bi.
• Read the title of the story. Look at the illustration.
• Say: Gis na njaboot gi ci nataal bi. Nungi booloo  taxaw nataalu.
• Continue through the book. Stop at each picture but do not read the story.
• Say: Soo xoole nataal bi ci léeb bi, lan ngeen foog ne moo war a xew?
• Give pupils less than a minute to look, then call on a pupil at random asking for their prediction. 
Then call on another pupil at random asking for their prediction. If pupils are having difficulty 
making a prediction, share one of your own.
Vocabulary Review
• On the pages that have a vocabulary word, stop and draw pupil attention to the word.
• Say: Fan lanu gis sunu baat bu fés bi  'nataal' ci nataal bi? 
• Call on a pupil at random. Affirm the correct answer or attempt, let them know if it is correct, 
and clarify the answer. If pupils have trouble finding the word in the picture, remind them of 
the meaning of the word.

lessons.homework:
• Ask learners to teach their family members the new vocabulary words they learnt 
today.

• Say: Na ku nekka, toog fi mu toog. Seetleen tur bi nu binda ci karta bi. Dinaa ékati benna tur ci

tur, toogal fi nga nekka.

continue with another name. Do as many names as possible in time allotted.

NATAALU NJABOOT GI
Faatu mu ngi ca waañ wa di déglu waxtaani mag ñi. Nafi ne xaaral ma indi ay nataal, mu indi 
téere nataal bu maget mu ubi ko, ñép di xool nataal yi. Mariyaama ne, "Céy! kii yow la Nafi bi nga 
nekkee xale, waay bii moom ci sa bési takka la woon", nijaay ne," Xoolal! Xoolal! kii moo di sunu 
mag Nuhaa." Noom ñép di xool nataali njaboot gi, Mariyaama joxoñ benna nataal ree, nijaay joxoñ 
beneen nataal ree be kekku ca kow, Nafi moom nekka di xool rek di xelaat. Faatu moom dafa am 
naqar, mu jóg ndànka nadnka dem ca ëttu wallaa ba di jooy.
Mariyaama ne, "Ana Faatu?" Nijaay ne, "Léegi la génna", Nafi ne ko, "xaaral ma seeti ko". Nafi gis 
Faatu, lénga ko, laaj ko "Lan ngaa jooy suma xarit?"
Faatu ñisabu ne ko, "Nekkuma ci benna nataal, ñépangi ci nataal yi be mu des man, Mariyaama 
mungi ci nataal yi, ijaay a ngi ci nataal yi, yow itam yaa ngi ci nataal yi."
Nafi neexal ko, nax ko mu nóppi, Mu wax ko ndànka. "Faatu nataal yii balaa ngaa juddu la woon 
waay jamano jóoju yép mangi àndoon ak yow góm ne dinaa am doom ju jigèen ju rafet be mel ni 
yow te moo yow mii." Nafi wéey ne, "kaay, nanu jél sa nataali xaleyaa yi nu won ko Mariyaama ak 
nijaayam' Faatu mujjée gis nataali xaleyaam ak yeneen nataal yi. Ci nóonu la Faatu gis boppam ci
nataali njaboot gi.

activities.content:
Read Aloud
Read the story. While reading, make sure pupils are paying attention and putting their hands on 
their head when a vocabulary word is said. At each vocabulary word, stop and review its meaning 
in the story. 
NATAALU NJABOOT GI
Faatu mu ngi ca waañ wa di déglu waxtaani mag ñi. Nafi ne xaaral ma indi ay nataal, mu indi 
téere nataal bu màgget mu ubi ko, ñép di xool nataal yi. Mariyaama ne, "Céy! kii yow la Nafi binga 
nekkee xale la, waay bii moom ci sa bési takka la woon", nijaay ne," Xoolal! Xoolal! kii moo di sunu 
mag Nuhaa." Noom ñép di xool nataali njaboot gi, Mariyaama joxoñ benna nataal ree, nijaay joxoñ 
beneen nataal ree be kekku ca kow, Nafi moom nekka di xool rek di xelaat. Faatu moom dafa am 
naqar, mu jóg ndànka dem ca ëttu wallaa ba di jooy.
Mariyaama ne, "Ana Faatu?" Nijaay ne, "Léegi la génna", Nafi ne ko, "Xaaral ma seeti ko". Nafi 
gis Faatu, lénga ko, laaj ko "Lan ngaa jooy suma xarit?"
Faatu ñisabu ne ko, "Nekkuma ci benna nataal, ñép a ngi ci nataal yi be mu des man, Mariyaama 
mu ngi ci nataal yi, Nijaay a ngi ci nataal yi, yow itam yaa ngi ci nataal yi."
Nafi neexal ko, nax ko mu noppi, Mu wax ko ndànka. "Faatu nataal yii balaa ngaa juddu la woon 
waay jamano jóoju yép maa ngi àndoon ak yow góm ne dinaa am doom ju jigèen ju rafet be mel ni 
yow te moo di yow mii." Nafi wéey ne, "Kaay, nanu jél sa nataali xaleyaa yi nu won ko Mariyaama 
ak nijaayam' Faatu mujje gis nataali xaleyaam ak yeneen nataal yi. Ci nóonu la Faatu gis boppam 
ci nataali njaboot gi.

activities.title: Letter of the Week
activities.content:
Learning Letter "g"
• Write the small letter "g" very big on the board. Point to the letter.
• Say: Bi moo di sunu arafu bés bu ay bi. Riiru araf bii moo /g/. Accaleen nu waxandoor ko /g/.
• Point to the letter on the board or letter card, say the sound, have pupils repeat 3 times 
slowly.
• Write the capital letter "G" very big on the board. Point to the capital letter.
• Say:  Lii benna araf bi la /G/. Moom itam riiru /G/ la. Dina nu ko jéfoo sunoo binda ci tàmbali 
kàddu, turi nit walla béréb.
• Point to the letter on the board or letter card, say the sound, have pupils repeat 3 times 
slowly.
• Point to the small letter "g" on the board or letter card or on the board again.
• Say: Li ci gën a bari nii lanu koo gise  ci baat yi.

activities.title: Writing
activities.content:
Learning Writing Concepts
• Say: Dina nu jànga te jéem ni nu war a binde bu baax. Balaa noo tàmbali danu war a fudda 
sunu loxo yi.
• Warm up exercise: have pupils push their palms together as hard as they can for 10 seconds. 
Then release and shake hands for 10 seconds. Repeat two more times.

• Give each pupil a pencil and demonstrate the proper way to hold a pencil.
 Say: Sunoo binda, danoo tàmbale càmmoñ jém ndeyjoor ak dale ci kow jém ci suuf. Mu mel 
ni soo tiye sa xalimba bi ak di dawale sa loxo jém ci kow. Léegi, nanu jéem a binda dale ci 
càmmoñ jém ci ndeyjoor, te dale ci kow jém ci suuf, mu mel ni, ni nu nu ko defee ci kéyit gi. 
Go through the motions of moving a pencil in the air. Pupils follow you. Have the pupils make 
specific motions like dashes or loops. Look around and make sure pupils are going in the 
proper direction (left to right, then moving down as if moving to a new line).
• Say: Léegi nanu jéem ci sunu taabul yi. Jéfool li ngaay jéfoo ni xalimba te tàmbale binda ca 
kow ci koñi  càmmoñ bi. Dawaleel sa loxo ni ku di binda ci  taabul bi. Soo bindeee ba ca cat la, 
jélal  beneen rédda, tàmbalee ci càmmoñ dem ndeyjoor, wéeyale di binda wàcca ci suuf. 
• Walk around and make sure pupils are demonstrating correct direction of writing. Continue to 
the next line, stopping to check pupil progress before going on.

Making Predictions: Illustration
• Show the illustration. Read the title while pointing to each word. 

• Say: Nanu xool nataal bii. Lan ngeen gis? 
• Give the pupils a minute to look and think. 
• Call on a pupil at random asking for their answer. 
• Say: Nanu xoolaat nataal bi te njorta lan moo war a xew. Lan ngeen foog ne moo xew ci léeb 
bi? Gómmaleen te xelaat lan ngeen foog ne moo war a xew ci léeb bi.

prediction.

activities.title: Comprehension: During Reading
activities.content:
Read Aloud
• Read aloud the story. Stop after a few pages/sentences.
• Say: Lan ngeen foog ne moo xew ci léeb bi? Gómmaleen te jéfoo seen xelaat ci lan ngeen foog 
ne moo war a xew ci léeb bi. 
• Call on a pupil at random to give their prediction. Stop 2-3 times during the story.
MBAXANA MUUS MI 
Muus dafa dékkoon ak jabaram ak seen doom ci néeg bu em, te rafet.
Benna bés ci suba, muus mu ndaw mi ne, "Yaa dama bëgga jëndi mbaxana" "Mbaxana! "Yaayam 
laaj ko." "Nga ne lan?" muus mu di jéndi mbaxana? Fan nga musa gis muus mu sol mbaxana?" 
Baayam ñów fekka leen ñu ngee wax mu laaj ko "Fan ngaa dem? muus mu ndaw mi tontu ko ne, 
"Da maa dem ci dëkka ba jéndi mbaxana." Baayam ne ko "Nga ne lan? Ndax mus ngaa gis muus 
mu sol mbaxana?" muus mu ndaw mi ne ko "Déedéet. Baayam di ko ree naan: "Xa xa xa xa xaa..." 
waay betey muus mu ndaw mi maa ngi bëgga dem ca dëkka ba. Muus mu ndaw mi daje ak magam 
bu góor, mu laaj ko: "Fan ngaa dem?" mu tontu ko ne, "Da maa dem ca dëkka ba jéndi mbaxana." 
Magam ree ne ko, "Nga ne lan? Muus bu di jéndi mbaxana? Fan nga musa gise muus mu sol 
mbaxana." Waay betey lóolu taxul mu bàyyi.
Muus mu ndaw mi dem ca dëkka ba jénda mbaxana mu rafet a rafet am wirgo yu bari, yóbbu ko 
seen kër.
Yaayam, baayam ak magam yép bég ci mbaxana muus mu ndaw mi.

slowly.

activities.title: Writing
activities.content:
Learning Writing Concepts
• Say: Dina nu jànga te jéem ni nu war a binde bu baax. Balaa noo tàmbali danu war a fudda 
sunu loxo yi.
• Warm up exercise: have pupils push their palms together as hard as they can for 10 seconds. 
Then release and shake hands for 10 seconds. Repeat two more times.
• Give each pupil a pencil and demonstrate the proper way to hold a pencil.
• Say: Sunoo binda, danoo tàmbale càmmoñ jém ndeyjoor ak dale ci kow jém ci suuf. Mu mel 
ni soo tiye sa xalimba bi ak di dawale sa loxo jém ci kow. Léegi, nanu jéem a binda dale ci 
càmmoñ jém ci ndeyjoor, te dale ci kow jém ci suuf, mu mel ni, ni nu nu ko defee ci kéyit gi.
• Go through the motions of moving a pencil in the air. Pupils follow you. Have the pupils make 
specific motions like dashes or loops. Look around and make sure pupils are going in the 
proper direction (left to right, then moving down as if moving to a new line).
• Say: Léegi nanu jéem binda ci sunu kéyit yi. Jéfooleen lu mel ni xalimba te tàmbalebinda ca 
kow koñi  càmmoñ bi. Dawaleel seen loxo melal ni kuy binda ci taabul bi. Soo binde ba ca cat 
la, jàllal ci beneen rédda bi. Wéey di binda doore càmmoñ dem ndeyjoor, ak jogé ci kow jém 
suuf
• Walk around and make sure pupils are demonstrating correct direction of writing. Continue to 
the next line, stopping to check pupil progress before going on.

activities.title: Reason to Read
activities.content:

• Think about how we read a book. Show the cover
• Say: Naka lanu jàngee téere?
• Call on a pupil at random to come and point to the book: top to bottom and left to right.
• Say: Naka la noo ubee téere ci xët benna benna?
• Call on a pupil at random to come and point to the book: front to back.

activities.title: Comprehension: Before Reading
activities.content:
Making Predictions: Illustration
• Show the illustration. Read the title while pointing to each word. 
• Say: Nanu xool nataal bii. Lan ngeen gis?
• Give the pupils a minute to look and think. Call on a pupil at random asking for their answer. 
• Say: Nanu xoolaat nataal bi te njorta lan moo war a xew. Lan ngeen foog ne moo war a xew ci 
léeb bi? Gómmaleen te xelaat lan ngeen foog ne moo xew ci léeb bi.  
• Give the pupils a minute to look and think. Call on a pupil at random asking for their 
prediction. After the answer, ask why they made the prediction.

activities.title: Comprehension: During Reading
activities.content:
Read Aloud
• Read aloud the story. Stop after a few pages/sentences.
• Say: Lan ngeen foog ne moo xew ci léeb bi? Gómmaleen te jéfoo seen xelaat ci li ngeen foog ne 
moo xew ci léeb bi. 
• Call on a pupil at random to give their prediction. Stop 2-3 times during the story.
SAMBA AK SEELA
Samba xale bu gòor bu ñenenti at la, ñenenti at la am. Samba dafa amoon benna xaj bu tudda 
Seela am lu nuul ak lu weex ci yaramam. Samba ak Seela ay xarit lanu, te dañu dee defandoor lu 
bari .Benna bés Samba mu ne dafaa tàggat Seela. Mu sànni benna et fu sóri, ne Seela, "Demal 
jélalima et wi". Seela wàncal, daw dem Jéli et wi, indi ko.
Samba wan Seela ab pax bu ndaw. Mu ne Seela,"gasal ma pax mi jàppal ma janax ju fa nekka." 
Seela wàncal tàmbali di gas be jàppa janax ji.
Samba joxoñ ay picca yu nekka di cob ci mboqa mi, mu ne Seela, "jàppal ma si benna pica." Seela 
wàncal daxee picca yi be jàppa si benna picca
Samba joxoñ Kiiki, muus mi dëkka ci kër gi ne, "Seela daxal Kiiki." Seela wàncal tàmbali di daxee 
Kiiki. Kiiki daw. Bi ngoon jotee, njugub yi di naaw ci asamaan si. Samba ñemewul njugub, moo 
jooy. Seela wàncal tàmbali di bow njugub yi. Njugub yi naaw dem. Samba fob Seela neko."Seela 
dëgga dëgga, yow mii yaa di suma xarit déggantaan."

if that's what happened? After the response, affirm the correct answer or attempt, let them 

know if it is correct, and clarify the answer.
Factual Questions: Who?
• Show an illustration with the character.
• Say: Léeb bu nekka daffa am luko dundal mën na nekka nit walla rab. Léeb bi mbiri ñii la. Ñii. 
Kan ngeen ci gis ci nataal bi?

them know if it is correct, and clarify the answer. 
• Say: Baatu 'kan' moo dee wone nit walla rab ci léeb bi.

character in the picture. Repeat if there are more characters in the story.

• Say: Sunu waaru bés bu ay bii moo 'Rab yi ci li nu wór'. Misaal yi ci wórngal bi ndax méngoo na 
ak waar wi?

• Say: Lii lan la?

Da noo jànga

 Say: Su noo binda, danoo binda jóge càmmoñ jém ndeyjoor te dale ci kow jém suuf. Mu mel

activities.title: Comprehension: During Reading
activities.content:
Making Predictions: Illustration
• Show the illustration. Read the title while pointing to each word. 
• Say: Nanu xool nataal bi. Lan ngeen gis?

• Give the pupils a minute to look and think. Call on a pupil at random asking for their answer. 
• Say: Nanu xoolaat nataal bi te wax lan moo war a xew. Lan nga foog ne moo xew ci léeb bi? 
Gómmal te xelaat lan nga foog ne moo war a xew ci léeb bi.
• Give the pupils a minute to look and think. Call on a pupil at random asking for their 
prediction. After the answer, ask why they made the prediction.

activities.title: Comprehension: During Reading
activities.content:
Read Aloud
• Read aloud the story. Stop after a few pages/sentences.
• Say: Lan nga foog ne moo war a xew? Gómmal te jéfoo sa xelaat ci lin nga foog ne moo war a 
xew ci léeb bi.
• Call on a pupil at random to give their prediction. Stop 2-3 times during the story.
BINTA DAFA SIBIRU
Binta ak wayjuram yi noo dékka. Wayjuram yi di oote, "Bintaa! Bintaa!" Néeg bi wéet ne tek. 
Binta tontuwuleen. "Ana Binta?" Binta dégga na leen waay uyuwul mungi tédda ci lal bi rek.
Wayjuram yi xoolante, yaayam daw dugga ci néegi Binta ne ko: "Binta jàmma nga fanaan? Naka 
nga def?" Binta ne ko: "Yaay dama feebar." 
Yaayam teg loxoom bi ci jéyu Binta bi ne ko "Sa yaram baa ngi tànga jirr, xaaral ma oo fajkat bi," 
baayam oo fajkat bi ci telefun, fajkat bi ñów seet Binta be sottal ne ko; "Danga sibiru. Dinaa la jox 
garabi sibiru." Biiri Bnta bi di métti, mu laaj fajkat bi ne ko, "Ndax damaa dee?" Fajkat bi ree neko 
"Dèedèet Binta, dinaa la jox garab yu baax be nga wér te di nga nelaw." Yaayam gérém fajkat bi 
neko "jéréjéf." Fajkat bi wax wayjuri Binta ne leen, "Bu leen fàtte di ko jox garabam yi te jòxee 
ko ko ni ma leen ko waxe waay na tédda ci sanke bu am garab ngir aaru ci sibiru." Yaayam xool 
baayam ne ko, "Nanu jéndi sanke bu am garab tey." Binta tédda ci lal bi di leen déglu.

activities.content:
Prediction Check
• Remind the class what they predicted would happen based on the illustration. Ask the pupils 
if that's what happened? After the response, affirm the correct answer or attempt, let them 
know if it is correct, and clarify the answer.

Factual Questions: Who and What?
• Show the illustration.
•  Say: kan moo gën a fés ci leebi? (Tontu: Binta mu ndaw).
• Call on a pupil at random to answer. Affirm the correct answer or attempt, let them know if it 
is correct, and clarify the answer.
•  Say: Ñi ci léeb am nañu ci taxawaay bu am solo. Lii moo di seen defin yi. Lii la ñi ci léeb di def. 
Lan la ñi nekka ci nataal bi di def?

them know if it is correct, and clarify the answer. 
• Say: Baatu 'Lan' dafaa laajte lan la ñi gën a fés ci léeb bi di def, walla lan moo xew ci léeb bi.
• Point to the character's name in the story. Call on a pupil at random to come and point to the 
character in the picture. Find the character's action in the story.

activities.title: Oral Language Development: Community Circle Time
activities.content:
Greeting
• Welcome pupils and have them sit in a circle. 
• Follow the normal greeting routine.
• Have the pupil that was just greeted, turn to the pupil on their right and greet them. This 
continues all the way around the circle.
Theme Discussion
• Before school starts, bring in two items related to the theme to show the pupils. {preferably 
medicince-syrup} Put the items in the center of the circle. If no items are available, draw two 
pictures on the board instead.
• Say:  Sunu waaru bés bu ay bii moo di "(SumaDékkuwaay)" misaal yi ci xaatimi bii méngoo na 
ak waar wi.
• Hold up one of the items from the center of the circle. 
• Say: Lii lan la?
• Call on a pupil at random to answer.
• Say: Lan ngeen mën a wax ci lii. Leeralal ma ko?
• Call on 2-3 pupils at random to answer. Repeat with the second item.
• Say: Kan moo dee toppatoo nit ñi feebar?
• Give pupils one minute to think, even close their eyes to picture their response. Then choose 
one of the following options for discussion: call on pupils at random, Turn and Talk (have 
pupils turn to a pupil next to them), go around the circle and allow every pupil to answer (only 
if the answer is short), or have pupils take turns acting out answers.
• Encourage pupils to bring in their own items relating to the theme throughout the week.

Amul xaajale amul xaajale Pulaar ñówal

• Say: Baatu "lan" dafaa laajte jéf yu ñi gën a fés ci léeb bi di def, walla lan moo xew ci léeb bi.
• Hold up one of the items from the center of the circle. 
• Say: Lan ngeen ma mën a wax ci li?
• Call on a pupil at random to answer.
• Say: Ban léeb ngeen foog ne la maam bóoy léebal Jàllo?
• Call on 2-3 pupils at random to answer. Repeat with the second item.
• Say: Lii lan la?
• Give pupils one minute to think, even close their eyes to picture their response. Then choose 
one of the following options for discussion: call on pupils at random, Turn and Talk (have 
pupils turn to a pupil next to them), go around the circle and allow every pupil to answer (only 
if the answer is short), or have pupils take turns acting out answers.
• Encourage pupils to bring in their own items relating to the theme throughout the week.
Activity
• Play: Song/Rhyme/Game

Amul xaajale amul xaajale Joola ñówal 
Amul xaajale amul xaajale Manjaago ñówal 
Amul xaajale amul xaajale Pulaar ñówal
Amul xaajale, amul xaajale Séeréer ñówal 
Amul xaajale amul xaajale Sóoninke ñówal 
Amul xaajale amul xaajale Wolof ñówal
Amul xaajale amul xaajale nun ñép benna lanu.

activities.title: Learning Sounds
activities.content:
Song to Identify Syllables
• Teach the following song: A new song/Rhyme

Tey jii danoo  jàànga dogiti baat, 
danoo  jàànga, 
danoo  jàànga dogiti baat 
• Sing the song 1-2 times.
• Say: Danoo wóyaat wóy wi, waay bii yoon, danoo tàccu, sunu waxe dogiti baat. Dogiti baat ab 
 dogit la ci baat mel ni /mo ak to/. Tàcculeen te déglu bu baax wóyin wu bees bi ma leen di 
won.
• Demonstrate singing and tapping hand for each syllable. Then lead pupils in doing the same. 
Sing 1-2 more times. 
• Other options: stepping or clapping for each syllable.
• Repeat with another rhythm. (Rhythm examples: 2 slow-2 fast-2 slow-1 fast)

activities.title: Alphabet
activities.content:
Name Card
• Put all the pupils' name cards on the floor or table. 
• Say: Suma leen ooye ngeen ñów ci kanam, xool seen tur yi. Soo leen ko gisé jél karta yi indil ma 
ko.
• Have pupils come up 2-3 at a time. When they bring you their card, point to their name and 
as they say it move your finger along the letters. Then have the pupil tap the syllables in their 
name.

activities.title: Letter of the Week
activities.content:
Learning Letter "j"
• Write the small letter "j" very big on the board. Point to the letter.
• Say: Lii moo di sunu arafu bés bu ay bi. Riiru araf bii moo /j/. Accaleen nu waxandoor ko /j/
• Hold up the letter card. 
• Say: Moo riiri /j/, te mungi jóge ci baatu "jaan" /j/ dafa jóge ci baat bi. Na ko xale yi bamtu 
"jaan" /j/.

activities.title: Writing
activities.content:
Learning Writing Concepts
•  Say: Dina nu jànga te jéem ni nu war a binde bu baax. Balaa noo tàmbali danu war a fudda 
sunu loxo yi.
• Warm up exercise: have pupils push their palms together as hard as they can for 10 seconds. 
Then release and shake hands for 10 seconds. Repeat two more times.
• Give each pupil a pencil and demonstrate the proper way to hold a pencil.

• Say: Su noo binda, danoo  tàmbale ci càmmoñ jém ndeyjoor, jóge ci kow jém ci suuf. Téyée   
 leen seen xalimba yi ni mu ware te ékati seen loxo yi ci kow. Léegi nanu jéem a dawale sunu   
 loxo jóge càmmoñ jém ndeyjoor ak jóge ci kow jém ci suuf, mu mel ni nu ko binde ci kéyit gi.
• Go through the motions of moving a pencil in the air. Pupils follow you. Have the pupils make 
specific motions like dashes or loops. Look around and make sure pupils are going in the 
proper direction (left to right, then moving down as if moving to a new line).
• Demonstrate on the board.
• Say: Sunoo binda, danoo  tàmbaleci càmmoñ jém ndeyjoor, jóge ci kow jém ci suuf. Téyéleen   
 seen xalimba yi ni mu ware te ékati seen loxo yi ci kow. Léegi nanu jéem a dawale sunu loxo   
 jóge càmmoñ jém ndeyjoor ak jóge ci kow jém ci suuf, mu mel ni nu ko binde ci kéyit gi.
• Walk around and make sure pupils are making marks from left to right. Continue to the next 
line, stopping to check pupil progress before going on.

lessons.homework:
• Ask learners to identify an object from their homes that starts with the letter sound of the day 
and report to class the next day.
• Ask learners to teach proper pencil grip to their family members.

activities.title: Vocabulary
activities.content:
Review and Discuss Words
• This activity has two objectives: To review vocabulary words, and to give pupils practice 
responding when they hear the vocabulary word. They will use these words and skills during 
the read aloud.
• Words:
léeb  lal
• Write the first word on the board, say it aloud, and have pupils repeat. Call on a pupil at 
random and ask if they remember what the word means. Affirm the correct answer or attempt, 
let them know if it is correct, and clarify the definition.
• Say: Dinaa tàccu ay baat su ngeen déggee baat yi fés ngeen teg seen loxo yi ci seen boppa yi:
• Say: palaat, ndox, sukaar, léeb.
• Make sure pupils are putting their hands on their head when you say the vocabulary word. Say 
it again if they need to hear the words a second time.
• Repeat all steps with remaining word.
• Say:  Duggalal ñetti baat yu am ñaareli  baat yu fés yii: foyeekaay, moto, lal

activities.title: Vocabulary: Before Reading
activities.content:
Vocabulary: Listen and Find
• Say: Sumaa jànga, dégluleen bu baax te bàyyi xel ci sunu baat yu fés yi.
• Say each word out loud.
• Say: Sooleen déggee baat bi, tegleen seen loxo yi ci seen kow boppa yi mel ni nu nu ko 
defewoon.

activities.title: Vocabulary: During Reading
activities.content:
Read Aloud
• Read the story. While reading, make sure pupils are paying attention and putting their hands 
on their head when a vocabulary word is said. At each vocabulary word, stop and review its 
meaning in the story.
JÀLLO BËGGUTA NELAW 
Jàllo mungee fo di wór ci néeg bi ak moto foyeekaayam bi. Bëgguta dem téddi nelaw. Yaayam ne 

Jàllo mu ngee fo di wór ci néeg bi ak moto foyeekaayam bi. Bëggula dem téddi nelaw. Yaayam ne 
ko: "Waxtu tédda nelaw jotna." Jàllo faalewul ko, mu wéey di fo, di wór ci néeg bi. Yaayam ne ko: 
"Jàllo demal raxas sa gémméñ bi, waxtu tédda jot na." Jallo faalewul ko, mu wéy di fo di wór ci 
néeg bi. Yaayam ne ko: "Bàyyil li ngaa def te ñow tédda." Betey Jàllo faalewu ko, mu wéey di fo, 
di wór ci néeg bi. Yaayam ne ko: "Kaay tédda ma léebal la. Jallo bàyyi fo mi teg moto foyeekaay bi 
féle, daw dem ci lal bi tédda di xaar léeb bi.
Yaayam tàmbali léeb, ne ko: léeboon.

activities.title: Comprehension: After Reading
activities.content:
Identify a Character's Actions
• Show the illustration of the story.
• Say: (Answers: Jàllow's Mama/ Jàllow don't want to sleep, Jàllow kept playing with his toy 
car). 
• Ñan noo nekka ci léeb bi? Yan jéf la ñi nekka ci léeb bi di def?
• Tontu: Ay nit ñoo nekka ci léeb bi. 
• yaayi Jàllo / Jàllo bëgguloon a nelaw, Jàllo moo doon fo ak moto foyeekaayam bi. 
• Call on a pupil at random to answer the question. Affirm the correct answer or attempt, let 
them know if it is correct, and clarify the answer. 
• Then have pupils take turns acting out the character doing different actions from the story.

activities.title: Weekly Theme
activities.content:
Syllables in Vocabulary: Weekly Theme
• Words: 
Fajkat /Faj/ kat /garab /ga/rab
• Say: Dégluleen bu baax baat yu fés yi.
• Say: Léegi danoo  wax dogiti baat yi ci baat bi. Seetaanleen ma njékka.

• Model by saying the vocabulary word, exaggerating each syllable, and raising a finger for each 
syllable. Then say the number of syllables.
• Say: Léegi nanu ko waxandoor.
• Repeat the process with the next vocabulary word. As pupils get better with counting 
syllables, add additional words relating to the theme of the week.

activities.title: Learning Sounds
activities.content:
Clap a Rhythm
• Say: Dinaa tàccu. Ku ci mën a tàccu ni ma ko defe nga ékati sa loxo.
• Start to clap a rhythm. When a pupil puts up their hand, stop and let them try to finish 
clapping the rhythm. If correct, go on to another rhythm. If wrong, have another pupil try. 
Continue 2-3 more times.
• Extension: Have a pupil start a new rhythm for the rest of the class to follow.

activities.title: Alphabet
activities.content:
Alphabet Song
• Say: Dina nu wóy ab wóy wu méngoo ak nu nu war a binde benna benna. Lii dina nu dimbale 
numën a jànga sunu araf yi.
• Sing the alphabet song/chant: /a, b, c/ (a à  b c d e é ë  f h g I j k l  m n ñ ŋ o ó p  q r s t u w x y )

activities.title: Letter of the Week
activities.content:
Learning Letter "j"
• Ban araf lanu jàngoon ci bés bu ay bii? 
• Have the whole class answer.
• Say:  Lan moo di riiri araf bii?
• Have the whole class answer.
• Hold up the alphabet card for the letter. Point to the picture.
• Say: Arafu 'j' bii ban riir la taxawal?
• Have the whole class answer.
• Say: Na ma kenna jox baat bu am riiru /j/.
Call on 2 pupils at random to answer. After the response, affirm the correct answer or   
attempt, let them know if it is correct, and clarify the answer.

lessons.homework:
• Give each pupil a letter card and ask them to practice saying the letter name and sound with 
their family members.
• Ask learners to identify an object from their homes that starts with the letter sound of the day 
and report to class the next day.

activities.title: Comprehension: Check
activities.content:
Factual Question: Who and What?
• Read the title of the first story this week. 
• Say: Ñan ñoo nekka ci léeb bi? (Tontu: Binta, Baay, yaay, fajkat) 
• Call on a pupil at random to answer.
• Say: Lan la ki nekka ci léeb bi def? Tontu Binta dafa feebar baayam ak yaayam oo fajkat bi mu 
ñów ci kër gi faj Binta. Baayam dem ca teeru ba jéndi sanke. 

• Call on a pupil at random to answer. Affirm the correct answer or attempt, let them know if it 
is correct, and clarify the answer. 
• Have the pupil point to the character in the story. Find the character's action in the story.

activities.title: Oral Language Development: Community Circle Time
activities.content:
Greeting
• Welcome pupils and have them sit in a circle. 
• Say: Nu tàmbali bés bi ak nuyoo. Nanu nuyoo ak sunu loxo ndeyjoor. Na ku nekka ékati loxo     
            ndeyjooram.
• Check to make sure every pupil is holding up the right hand.
• Say: Saa yoo dajee ak nit, jakkaarlool ak moom, nuyu ko te céral ko.
• Turn to the pupil on your right, shake their hand.
• Say: Jàmma ngeen fanaan, (oo turi xale bi).
• Pupil should respond back saying "Good morning, teacher."
• Have the pupil that was just greeted, turn to the pupil on their right and greet them. This    
 continues all the way around the circle.
Theme Discussion
• Before school starts, bring in two items related to the theme to show the pupils. Put the    
 items in the center of the circle. If no items are available, draw two pictures on the board    
 instead.
• Say:  Sunu waaru bés bu ay bi moo di 'Ngédda.' Misaal yi ci pàcci bii yéppa méngoo ak waar wi.
• Hold up one of the items from the center of the circle. 
• Say: "Lii lan la?"
• Call on a pupil at random to answer.
• Say: Ban jokkoo la am ak Ngédda li?
• Call on 2-3 pupils at random to answer. Repeat with the second item.
• Say: Lan moo méngale mbir yii ak ngédda? 
• Give pupils one minute to think, even close their eyes to picture their response. Then      
 choose one of the following options for discussion: call on pupils at random, Turn and Talk    

      (have pupils turn to a pupil next to them), go around the circle and allow every pupil to answer        
 (only if the answer is short), or have pupils take turns acting out answers.
• Encourage pupils to bring in their own items relating to the theme throughout the week.

activities.content:
Identify Sounds: What Sound Am I Maing?
• Say: Dina nu wóy ab wóy wu méngoo ak nu nu war a binde benna benna. Lii dina nu dimbale nu 
mën a jànga sunu araf yi.
• Pupils close their eyes. Make a sound (example: tap desk with pencil, close the door, slide 
chair across floor, drop a book on the table). Then call on a pupil at random to describe 
the sound and guess what was used to make the sound. Call on another pupil if first was   
incorrect. Continue with another sound.

activities.title: Alphabet
activities.content:
Alphabet Song
• Say: Dina nu wóy ab wóy wu méngoo ak nu nu war a binde benna benna. Lii dina nu dimbale nu
• mën a jànga sunu araf yi. 
• Teach the alphabet song/chant: ( a à b c d e é ë    f h g I j k l    m n ñ ŋ o ó p    q r s t u w x y)

activities.title: Letter of the Week
activities.content:
Learning Letter: "a A" 
• Write the small letter "a" very big on the board. Point to the letter.
• Say:  Dina nu wóy wóyu abcd bi wu nuy dimbale ci ni nu war a toppalantee sunu araf yi benna 
benna. Lii dina nu dimbale nu mën a jànga sunu araf yi.
• Point to the letter on the board or letter card, say the sound, have pupils repeat 3 times   
slowly.
• Write the capital letter "A" very big on the board. Point to the capital letter.
• Say: Lii benna araf bi la. Moom itam riiru /A/ la. Gis nanu ne dina nu ko jéfoo sunoo binda ci 
tàmbali kàddu, turi nit walla béréb.
• Point to the letter on the board or letter card, say the sound, have pupils repeat 3 times 
slowly.
• Point to the small letter "a" on the board or letter card again.

• Say: Li ci gën a bari nii lanu koo gise ci baat yi.

activities.title: Writing
activities.content:
Fine Motor Development
• Say:. Dina nu tàggat sunu sadditi loxo yi ak yaram. Lii dina nu dimbale nu mën a binda bu 
baax. Ni sunu sadditi loxo yi gën a dégéreee, ci laa gën a yomba nu mën a jéfoo sunu loxo yi 
sunoo binda.
• Exercise is marching: standing in place the opposite arm swings forward to the raised knee 
(left arm and right knee together). As pupils march on the spot, give orders: low march knees 
raised slightly), normal march (knees raised to half raised), high march (knees raised as high 
as possible), left turn, right turn, face forward.
• Alternative exercise is the crab walk: (make sure the ground is not dirty so pupils do not soil 
their clothes) sit on the ground with legs extended out in front, place hands by side with 
fingers pointed toward feet, lift body up into the air, start moving forward or backwards. 
Have pupils try for one minute then have them stop and rest for a minute.    
• Then have them try again for another minute.

lessons.homework: Ask learners to teach their family members the letter name and sound they learnt today.

activities.content:
Teach and Discuss New Words
• Words:

• Say: Nanu jànga baat yu bees yi, mu dimbale nu, nu xam léeb bi bu baax. Am na baat yu fés yu  
nu war a jànga ci léeb bi.
• Say the first vocabulary word, but do not write it on the board. Then have pupils say the word 
aloud. Repeat two more times.

illustrations to support understanding. 
• If needed, help pupils understand the word by saying it in another language.
• Repeat all steps with remaining word.

activities.title: Before Reading & Reason to Read
activities.content:
Learn New Print Concepts
• Think about how we read a book. Show the cover.
• Say: Su noo jànga danoo dale ci kow wàcca ci suuf (joxoñal ak sa baaraam) jóge càmmoñ dem 
ndeyjoor (joxoñal ak sa baaraam) turi téere bi. Danuy ólbati kéyit gi jóge ci kanam dem ci 
ganaaw. 
• Have pupils follow the motions as you show on the book TOP to BOTTOM and RIGHT to LEFT 
and turn pages FRONT to BACK.

activities.title: Comprehension
activities.content:
Making Predictions: Picture Walk 
• Say: "Sunu xoole nataal yi méngoo ak léeb bi, dina nu dimbale nu xelaat naka la léeb bi di deme. 
Lii moo njorta li war a xew. Yenna saayi njorta mën na nekka mën na ñakka, waay nu mu deme 
rek, am na njériñ. Jàngakat bu baax war naa mën a njorta lan moo war a xew ci léeb."  
• Read the title of the story. Look at the illustration.
• Say: "Gis naa benna xale bu góor ak cabi banaana ci kow garabi banaana ci nataal bii. Foog naa 
ne léeb bi mbiri xale bu góor la ku bëgga lekka banaana. Dama xelaat lii ndax xale bu góor bi mu 
ngee xool cabi banaana yi te di xelaat nakka la koo sàkkee. 
• Continue through the book. Stop at each picture but do not read the story. 
• "Lan nga foog ne moo xew soo xoole nataal bi?"
• Give pupils less than a minute to look, then call on a pupil at random asking for their prediction. 
Then call on another pupil at random asking for their prediction. If pupils are having difficulty 
making a prediction, share one of your own.
Vocabulary Review
• On the pages that have a vocabulary word, stop and draw pupil attention to the word.
• Say: "Fan lanu gis sunu baat bu fés bi'banaana' ci nataal bi?"
• Call on a pupil at random. Affirm the correct answer or attempt, let them know if it is correct, 
and clarify the answer. If pupils have trouble finding the word in the picture, remind them of 
the meaning of the word.

lessons.homework: Ask learners to teach their family members the new vocabulary words they learnt today.

activities.title: Weekly Theme
activities.content:
Picture on the Ground: Weekly Theme
• Take class to an open space outside and give each pupil a stick or some object to draw in the 
dirt/sand with.
• Say: Da ngeen di defar nataal bu méngoo ak sunu waaru bés bu ay bi '(Suma Màggal). 
• Your picture should include things related to children, family, people and food. You can also 
include clothes. 
• Give pupils 5 minutes to create their picture. Then have them walk around looking at the  
different pictures. Pick one pupil at random to explain his/her picture. Make sure to connect 
the picture to the theme.

what was heard. Repeat with two more pupils. Please note that answers may vary

activities.content:

• Say: Ban baat moo am riiru /b/?
• Have the whole class answer.
• Say: Jox ma beneen baat bu am riiru /b/?
• Call on 2 pupils at random to answer. After the response, affirm the correct answer or 
attempt, let them know if it is correct, and clarify the answer.

activities.title: Vocabulary: During Reading
activities.content:
Read Aloud
Read the story. While reading, make sure pupils are paying attention and putting their hands on 
their head when a vocabulary word is said. At each vocabulary word, stop and review its meaning 
in the story.
Baykay bi ak mbaam mi
Dafa amoon benna baykat bu dëkka Pakaaw. Bés bu nekka, suba teel mu dem ci toolam. Su àggee 
dafa dee liggéey bu baax, dina dog gaji yi te ruuj tool bi ba mu set mu jémbat fa ñambi. Nambi ji 
jebbi, naat be. Mu di ko bay be mu ñor. Saayu mu jóge ci tool bi, dina indiwaale ñambi ci kër gi.
Baykat bi ku tabe la, mu mey ku nekka. Mu sédda buur bi ak lingeeram bi.
Benna bés buur bi ne; "Nanu tànna benna bés ngir xew, ku nekka na indi ci lu mu ñorle. Baykat bi 
ne ko; "Baax na dinaa indi ñambi. Bi moo  dem ci toolam bi mu tase ak mbaam. Mbaam nuyu ko ne 
ko; "Jàmma nga fanaan" baykat bi ne ko; "Jàmma rek."
Mbaam ne ko" "Ndax mën nga maa dimbale ci kéwél, mu ngee lekka suma tool bi rek." Baykat bi 
ne ko; "Su fekkee ne di nga ma dimbale, dinaa la dimbale." Mbaam nangu. Baykat bi war mbaam 
nuy daqa kéwél. Kéwél di daw di cirib ciribi ci tool bi be récca. kéwél a gën a gaaw mbaam waay 
baykat bi ne ko; "Am naa beneen pexe" mu uti sabar kéwél ñemewut téggi sabar mu daw ndax 
raggal sabar. Bés bóobu betey kéwél ñówatul di lekka ci tooli mbaam mi.
Mbaam ne baykat bi, "Dinaa la dimbale, ebal la ñambi yi yóobu ko ca  kër buur. Ña  ñ nekkoon kër 
buur ñëp bég. Buur ne mbaam; "Nun ñéppa bég nanu ci yow". "D anu bëgga nga dëkka ak nun 
su la neexee, nu ñaan ko, mbaam mi nangu. Bés bóobu betey ci la mbaam mi dëkka kër buur di 
dimbale nit ñi

activities.title: Learning Sounds
activities.content:
Identify Sounds: 
What Sound Am I Making?
• Say: Dinaa def ab yéngu. Gómmaleen seen te wax ma li ma jéfandekoo be def yéngu bi.
• Pupils close their eyes. Make a sound (example: tap desk with pencil, close the door, slide 
chair across floor, drop a book on the table). Then call on a pupil at random to describe the 
sound and guess what was used to make the sound. Call on another pupil if first was incorrect. 
Continue with another sound.

• Say: Dina nu wóy ab wóy wu méngoo ak nu nu war a binde benna benna. Lii dina nu dimbale nu

activities.title: Letter of the Week
activities.content:
Learning Letter: "c"
• Write the small letter "c" very big on the board. Point to the letter.
• Say:  Lii moo sunu arafu bés bu ay bi. Riiru araf bii moo di /c/. Accaleen nu waxandoor ko /c/.
• Point to the letter on the board or letter card, say the sound, have pupils repeat 3 times 
slowly.
• Write the capital letter "C" very big on the board. Point to the capital letter.
• Say: Lii benna araf bi la. Moom itam riiru /A/ la. Dina nuko jéfoo sunoo binda ci tàmbali kàddu, 
turi nit walla béréb.
• Point to the letter on the board or letter card, say the sound, have pupils repeat 3 times 
slowly.
• Point to the small letter "c" on the board or letter card again.  
•     Say: Li ci gën a bari nii lanu koo gise ci baat yi.

activities.title: Writing
activities.content:
Fine Motor Development
• Say: Dina nu tàggat sunu sadditi loxo yi ak yaram wi. Lii dina nu dimbale nu mën a binda bu 
baax. Ni sunu sadditi loxo yi gën a dégéree, ci lanoo gën a mën a jéfoo sunu loxo yi su noo 
binda.
• Exercise is marching standing in place the opposite arm swings forward to the raised knee 
(left arm and right knee together). As pupils march on the spot, give orders: low march 
(knbees raised slightly), normal march (knbees raised to half raised), high march (knbees 
raised as high as possible), left turn, right turn, face forward.
• Alternative exercise is the crab walk: (make sure the ground is not dirty so pupils do not soil 
their clothes) sit on the ground with legs extended out in front, place hands by side with 
fingers pointed toward feet, lift body up into the air, start moving forward or backwards. 
Have pupils try for one minute then have them stop and rest for a minute. Then have them try 
again for another minute.

lessons.homework:

their family members.

and report to class the next day.

activities.title: Comprehension: During Reading
activities.content:
Making Predictions: Picture Walk (Big Book)
• Say: Sunu xoole nataal yi méngoo ak léeb bi, dina nu dimbale nu xelaat naka la léeb bi di deme. 
Lii moo di njorta lu war a xew. Yenna saayi njorta mën na jub walla mu ñakka jub, waay nu mu 

deme rek am na njériñ. Jàngakat bu baax war naa mën a njorta li war a ñów ci léeb bi. Jàngal 
boppi léeb bi. Xoolal nataal bi.
• Read the title of the story. Look at the illustration.
• Say: Gis naa ay tabax yu uute. Foog naa ne léeb bi mbiri dékkuwaay yu uute. Ndax te néeg yi 
dañu uute..
• Continue through the book. Stop at each picture but do not read the story.
• Say: Soo xoole nataal bi nu méngale ak léeb bi, Lan nga foog ne moo war a xew.
• Give pupils less than a minute to look, then call on a pupil at random asking for their prediction. 
Then call on another pupil at random asking for their prediction. If pupils are having difficulty 
making a prediction, share one of your own.
Vocabulary Review
• On the pages that have a vocabulary word, stop and draw pupil attention to the word.
• Say: Fan lanu gis sunu baat bu fés bi 'dékkuwaay' ci nataal bi?
• Call on a pupil at random. Affirm the correct answer or attempt, let them know if it is correct, 
and clarify the answer. If pupils have trouble finding the word in the picture, remind them of the 
meaning of the word.

• Welcome pupils and have them sit in a circle. 
• Say: Nu tàmbali sunu bés bi ak nuyoo. Nanu nuyoo ak sunu loxo ndeyjoor. Na ku nekka ékati 
loxo ndeyjooram. 
• Check to make sure every pupil is holding up the right hand.
• Say: Saa yoo dajee ak nit, jakkaarlool ak moom, nuyu ko te céral ko.  
• Turn to the pupil on your right, shake their hand.
• Say: Jàmma nga fanaan, (oo turi xale bi).
• Pupil should respond back saying "Good morning, teacher."
• Have the pupil that was just greeted, turn to the pupil on their right and greet them. This 
continues all the way around the circle.
Theme Discussion
• Before school starts, bring in two items related to the theme to show the pupils. Put the items 
in the center of the circle. If no items are available, draw two pictures on the board instead.
• Say: Sunu waaru bés bu ay bii moo di'. "kër ak dékkuwaay"  yi nekka ci tabla ji méngoo na ak 
waar wi.
• Hold up one of the items from the center of the circle. 
• Say: Lii lan la?
• Call on a pupil at random to answer.
• Say: Lan ngeen ma mën a wax ci lii?
• Call on 2-3 pupils at random to answer. Repeat with the second item.
• Say: Lan lanu sunu njaboot gi defal?
• Give pupils one minute to think, even close their eyes to picture their response. Then choose 
one of the following options for discussion: call on pupils at random, Turn and Talk (have 
pupils turn to a pupil next to them), go around the circle and allow every pupil to answer (only 

if the answer is short), or have pupils take turns acting out answers.
• Encourage pupils to bring in their own items relating to the theme throughout the week.

• Teach the following song: (insert a song)
• Say: Benna ñaar takkal sa dàlla, ñetta, ñenent koŋ-koŋ bunta, juróom, juróom benna jélal

• Say: Danoo wóyaat wóy wi, waay bii yoon danu koo wóy mu uute. Bii yoon baat bu nu wax 
ngeen rippi seen tànka. Dégluleen bu baax ma won leen wóyin wu bees wi te ngeen rippiwaale 
seen tànka yi
•  Dina nu rippi sunu tanka.

more times while stepping for each word.
• Other options: Clap or jump for each word.

activities.title: Alphabet
activities.content:
Name Card #1
• Before the lesson, create two name cards for each pupil with their first name.
• Give each pupil their name card and you keep the other set. 
• Say: Na ku nekka toog fi mu toog. Seetleen tur bi nu binda ci karta bi. Dinaa ékati benna tur ci 
kow, na ku nekka seet ndax méngoo na ak sa bos. Su nekkee sa tur, ñówal ci man. Su nekkul sa 
tur, toogal fi nga nekka.     
• Hold up a name card and walk around so every pupil can see the name. Once there is a match, 
continue with another name. Do as many names as possible in time allotted.
• If pupils are having difficulties, say the name written on the card.

Kër ak nit yu uute  
Ca dékki kow ya la Mariyaama dëkka, ca néegi ban bu nu xéddee ñax la dëkka. Mariyaama ku 
bëgga këram la. Benna bés, nijaayam ñów seet si ko jóge ca dékki taax ya. Mariyaama laaj ko; 
"Naka la seen kër mel?" Nijaayam tontu ko ne; "Mangi dèkka ci taax bu gudda ak suma njaboot." 
Suma kër am na tabax yu dégér, néeg yi am palanteer yu am weer. Kër gu réy lanu bokka." Kali 
Mariyaa bi, Faatu moom ci wetu dex gi la dëkka. Mariyaama dem fa seeti ko. Këri Faatu moom 
néegu tóoj bu kirinting la, mungi dëkka ca kow.
Mariyaama laaj ko, "Lan moo tax sa néeg bi kowe?" Faatu ne ko, "Su dex gi fbeesee walla moo 
taw, ndox mi du mën a éeg ci kow, su ko defe néeg bi du yol, du tooy te dina am na kaarange." 
Mariyaama dem seeti xaritam ba Lamin. Lamin moom ci mbaar la dëkka ndax ay mbokkam  
sàmmakat lanu, danu dee toxu lu bari ak seen jur gi. Fu am ñax rek nu dem fa ngir seen jur gi am 
lekka. Laamin tegal ko ci ne,"Nun sunoo toxu danu dee yóbbuwaale sunu mbaar mi." Mariyaama 
xelaat ne néeg yi yép ak dékkuwaay yi yép a uute te xam ne ku nekka am na kër gu uute ak  
moroma. Mariyaama ne, "Ku nekka am kër waay yép a uute te ku nekka ngi dëkka ak njambootam 
ci kaarange ak teranga.

• Say: Nu tàmbali bés bi ak nuyoo. Nanu nuyoo ak sunu loxo ndeyjoor. Na ku nekka ékati loxo 
ndeyjooram.  
• Check to make sure every pupil is holding up the right hand.
• Say:  Saa yoo dajee ak nit, jakkaarlool ak moom, nuyu ko te céral ko.  
• Turn to the pupil on your right, shake their hand.
• Say: Jàmma ngeen fanaan, (say Tontu: oo turi xale bi). 
• Pupil should respond back saying "Good morning, teacher." 
• Have the pupil that was just greeted, turn to the pupil on their right and greet them. This 
continues all the way around the circle.
Theme Discussion
• Before school starts, bring in two items related to the theme to show the pupils. Put the items 
in the center of the circle. If no items are available, draw two pictures on the board instead.
• Say: Sunu waaru bés bu ay bii moo 'Kër ak dékkuwaay.' Mbir yi nekka ci kéyit gi méngoo na ak 
waar wi.
• Hold up one of the items from the center of the circle. 
• Say: Lii lan la?
• Call on a pupil at random to answer
• Say: "Lan ngeen ma mën a wax ci lii?"
• Call on 2-3 pupils at random to answer. Repeat with the second item.
• Say: Lan moo tax ngeen foog ne njabooti Laamin gi danu soxla kër? Naka la këram uute ak kër 
Mariyaama? 
• Give pupils one minute to think, even close their eyes to picture their response. Then choose 
one of the following options for discussion: call on pupils at random, Turn and Talk (have 

pupils turn to a pupil next to them), go around the circle and allow every pupil to answer (only 
if the answer is short), or have pupils take turns acting out answers.
• Encourage pupils to bring in their own items relating to the theme throughout the week.
Activity
• Play:  Song/Rhyme
     Baay, yaay dëkka ci kër gi
     Mag ak rakka dëkka ci kër gi
     Yumpaañ, nijaay dëkka ci kër gi
     Fas ak mbaam ci dékkuwaay ba
     Rab yi yép ci dékkuwaay ba

activities.title: Learning Sounds
activities.content:
Identify Sounds: What Sound Am I Making?
• Say: Dinaa def ab yéngu. Gómmaleen seen bët yi te wax ma li ma jéfandekoo be def yéngu bi.
• Pupils close their eyes. Make a sound (example: tap desk with pencil, close the door, slide 
chair across floor, drop a book on the table). Then call on a pupil at random to describe the 
sound and guess what was used to make the sound. Call on another pupil if first was incorrect. 
Continue with another sound.

activities.title: Letter of the Week
activities.content:
Learning Letter: "c"
• Write the small letter "c" very big on the board. Point to the letter.
• Say: "Yii noo sunu arafi bés bu ay bi. Riiru araf bii moo /c/. Accaleen nu waxandoor ko /c/."
• Point to the letter on the board or letter card, say the sound, have pupils repeat 3 times 
slowly.
• Write the capital letter "C" very big on the board. Point to the capital letter.
• Say: Lii benna araf bi la. Moom itam riiru /C/ la. Dina nuko jéfoo sunoo binda ci tàmbali kàddu, 
turi nit walla béréb.
• Point to the letter on the board or letter card, say the sound, have pupils repeat 3 times 
slowly.
• Point to the small letter "c" on the board or letter card or on the board again.
• Say: Li ci gën a bari nii lanu koo gise  ci baat yi.

activities.title: Writing
activities.content:
Fine Motor Development
• Say: Dina nu tàggat sunu sadditi loxo yi ak yaram yi. Lii dina nu dimbale nu mën a binda bu 
baax. Nu sunu sadditi loxo yi gën a dégéree ci la noo gën a mën a jéfoo sunu loxo yi su noo 
binda.
• Exercise is marching standing in place the opposite arm swings forward to the raised knee 
(left arm and right knee together). As pupils march on the spot, give orders: low march 
(knbees raised slightly), normal march (knbees raised to half raised), high march (knbees 
raised as high as possible), left turn, right turn, face forward.
• Alternative exercise is the crab walk: (make sure the ground is not dirty, so pupils do not 
soil their clothes) sit on the ground with legs extended out in front, place hands by side with 
fingers pointed toward feet, lift body up into the air, start moving forward or backwards. 
Have pupils try for one minute then have them stop and rest for a minute. Then have them try 
again for another minute.

lessons.homework:
• Give each pupil a letter card and ask them to practice saying the letter name and sound with 
their family members.
• Ask learners to identify an object from their homes that starts with the letter sound of the day 
and report to class the next day.

• Say: Sunoo jànga danoo dale ci kow wàcca ci suuf (joxoñal ak sa baaraam) jóge càmmoñ dem
