activities.title: Comprehension: During Reading
activities.content:
Making Predictions: Picture Walk (Big Book)
• Say: Sunu xoole nataal yi méngoo ak léeb bi, dina nu dimbale nu xelaat naka la léeb bi di deme. 
Lii moo di njorta lu war a xew. Yenna saayi njorta mën na jub walla mu ñakka jub, waay nu mu 
deme rek am na njériñ. Jàngakat bu baax war naa mën a njorta liy ñów ci léeb bi. Jàngal boppi 
léeb bi. Xoolal nataal bi.  
• Read the title of the story. Look at the illustration.
• Say:'Gis naa picci baaxoñ. Foog naa léeb bi mbiri baaxoñ bu di liggéey bu baax te mar. Ma 
xelaat ne ci tool bi la jóge te dafa sonna.
• Continue through the book. Stop at each picture but do not read the story.
• Say:  Soo xoolee nataal bi méngoo ak léeb bi, lan ngeen foog ne moo war a xew?'
• Give pupils less than a minute to look, then call on a pupil at random asking for their 
prediction. Then call on another pupil at random asking for their prediction. If pupils are 
having difficulty making a prediction, share one of your own.
Vocabulary Review
• On the pages that have a vocabulary word, stop and draw pupil attention to the word.
• Say: Fan ngeen gis baat bi fés bi 'baaxoñ' ci nataal bi?
• Call on a pupil at random. Affirm the correct answer or attempt, let them know if it is correct, 
and clarify the answer. If pupils have trouble finding the word in the picture, remind them of 
the meaning of the word.

Name Card 
• Before the lesson, create two name cards for each pupil with their first name.

• Say: Na ku nekka toog fi mu toog. Seetleen tur bi nu binda ci karta bi. Dinaa ékati benna tur ci

tur, toogal fi nga nekka.    
• Hold up a name card and walk around so every pupil can see the name. Once there is a match, 
continue with another name. Do as many names as possible in time allotted.

Baaxoñ bu mar
Dafa amoon benna baaxoñ bu muus. Benna bés ci noor mu tànga lool, baaxoñ mar lool bëgga naan 
te amut ndox. Mu ne xaaral ma xaar be nawet, bu tawee ma naan. Mu toog di xaar lu yàgga lool 
waay tawut. Baaxoñ gën a mar, ngalaw li wow, naaj wi tànga, asamaan si xiinul. Baaxoñ dogu ne 
"Damaa uti ndox mu ma naan balaa maa dee.' Mu tàmbali di naaw di wór ci àlla bi, di naaw ci doj 
yi ak xur yi waay amul benna ndox mu mu naan. Moo yurndu ci ron gajji yi gisul dara, mu naaw be 
ci ron benna garab rek, mu gis fa lu doy waar. Benna ndaal lu am ndox mu tuuti. 
Baaxoñ jotul ndox mi, mënula naan. Mu ne: "Man naka laa war a def be naan ci ndox mii ci ndaal 
li?" Baaxoñ di tób di wór ndaal li wet gu ne jotul ndox mi. Mu békka ndaal li ngir ndox mi tuuru 
mu naan te amul kàttan waay xàddiwul, bayyiwul. Mu for doj yu sew te bari di leen sanni ci biir 
ndaal li benna benna corox, corox, corox, ndox mi di éeg tuuti tuuti be egsi ci kow ndaal li. Baaxoñ 
taxaw ci kéméju ndaal li, di naan, di naan, di naan be mandi. Mu bég ci boppam lool. Baaxoñ 
mënula wòy waay mën naa lapi lapi di dem doxi yeneen soxlaam.

Read Aloud

their head when a vocabulary word is said. At each vocabulary word, stop and review its meaning

Kër ak nit yu uute 
Ca dékki kow ya la Mariyaama dëkka, ca néegi ban bu nu xéddée ñax la dëkka. Mariyaama ku 
bëgga këram la. Benna bés, nijaayam ñów seet si ko jóge ca dékki taax ya. Mariyaama laaj ko; 
"Naka la seen kër mel?" Nijaayam tontu ko ne; "Mangi dèkka ci taax bu gudda ak suma njaboot." 
Suma kër am na tabax yu dégér, néeg yi am palanteer yu am weer. Kër gu réy lanu bokka." Kali 
Mariyaa bi, Faatu moom ci wetu dex gi la dëkka. Mariyaama dem fa seeti ko. Këri Faatu moom 
néegu tóoj bu kirinting la, mu ngi dëkka ca kow.
Mariyaama laaj ko, "Lan moo tax sa néeg bi kowe?" Faatu ne ko, "Su dex gi fbeesee walla mu di 
taw, ndox mi du mën a éeg ci kow, su ko defee néeg bi du yol, du tooy te dina am na kaarange."
Mariyaama dem seeti xaritam ba Lamin. Lamin moom ci mbaar la dëkka ndax ay mbokkam 
sàmmakat lanu, danu dee toxu lu bari ak seen jur gi. Fu am ñax rek nu dem fa ngir seen jur gi am 
lekka. Laamin tegal ko ci ne, "nun sunoo toxu danu dee yóbbuwaale sunu mbaar mi." Mariyaama 
xelaat ne néeg yi yép ak dékkuwaay yi yép a uute te xam ne ku nekka am na kër gu uute ak 
moroma. Mariyaama ne, "Ku nekka am kër waay yép a uute te ku nekka ngi dëkka ak njambootam 
ci kaarange ak teranga.

activities.content:

• Say: Sunu xoole nataal yi méngoo ak léeb bi,dina nu dimbale nu xelaat naka la léeb bi di deme.

and clarify the answer. If pupils have trouble finding the word in the picture, remind them of 
the meaning of the word.

Bésu Omar Bu Njékka Ca Jànguwaay Ba
Omar teel a eewu, tey moo bés bu moo tàmbali njànga. Mu ne: "Tey sawar naa lool waay dama 
xawa tiit. Yaayam dimbale ko mu solu be jag. Yaayam ne ko: "Yangi rafet lool." Bi nu demee ca 
jànguwaay ba, Omar gis fa xale yu bari, ñii nungee fo, ñii di jooy, ñenna ñi raggal. Omar xawa tiit 
mu ne yaayam: "Damaa ñibbi ca kër ga."
Benna jigèen bu rafet ñów, ne: "Man jàngalekat laa, Mariyaama laa tudda, naka nga def? 
Mariyaama muuñ ne Omar "Yow yaay Omar? kaay seet kalaas bi. Mu won ko ay téere ak ay 
foyeekaay, mu won ko fi noo léebée ak fu noo foyee.
Omar gis fa benna xale bu tudda Saaliw. Mu ne Omar: "Man itam dama tiitoon, waay jànguwaay bi 
neex na te bari foyeekaay. Ñu léebal leen léeb yu neex ci rab yi. Ñu wóy fa wóyu wañi yu neex. Ñu 
lekkandoor fa suusal. Omar am na xarit te jànga na lu bees.
 
Bi Yaayam ñówée jèl si ko mu fekka Omar di muuñ. Mu laaj ko: "Naka la jànguwaay bi melon tey? 
Omar tontu ko ne: "Neex na lool, damaa dellusi élég. Ca guddi ga mu wax baayam naka la bésam 
bu njékka ci jànguwaay ba neexe.

activities.title: Oral Language Development: Community Circle Time
activities.content:
Greeting
• Welcome pupils and have them sit in a circle. 
• Say: Nu tàmbali bés bi ak nuyoo. Nanu nuyoo ak sunu loxo ndeyjoor. Na ku nekka ékati loxo 
ndeyjooram.  
• Check to make sure every pupil is holding up the right hand.
• Say: Saa yoo dajeee ak  nuyu nit, xoolal xarkanamam bu baax nga oo turam, nuyu ko.
• Turn to the pupil on your right, shake their hand
• Say: Jàmma nga fanaan, (oo turi xale bi).
• Pupil should respond back saying "Good morning, teacher."
• Have the pupil that was just greeted, turn to the pupil on their right and greet them. This 
continues all the way around the circle.
Theme Discussion
• Before school starts, bring in two items related to the theme to show the pupils. Put the items 
in the centre of the circle. If no items are available, draw two pictures on the board instead.
• Say: Sunu waaru bés bu ay bii moo 'Suma njaboot gi.' Misaal yi nekka ci wórngal bi méngoo na 
ak waar wi.
• Hold up one of the items from the centre of the circle. 
• Say: Lii lan la?
• Call on a pupil at random to answer.
•  Say: Lan ngeen ma mën a wax ci li?
• Call on 2-3 pupils at random to answer. Repeat with the second item.
• Say: Ban ndimbal nga mosa am ci sa njaboot gi?
• Give pupils one minute to think, even close their eyes to picture their response. Then choose 
one of the following options for discussion: call on pupils at random, Turn and Talk (have 

pupils turn to a pupil next to them), go around the circle and allow every pupil to answer (only 
if the answer is short), or have pupils take turns acting out answers.
• Encourage pupils to bring in their own items relating to the theme throughout the week.
Activity
• Play: Song/Rhyme
Maam góor maam jigéen bëgga naa leen  
xool leen ma feccal leen ngir yeen rek.
Yaay bóoy baay booy bëgga naa leen  
xoolleen ma tàccul leen ngir yeen rek.
Bàjjen Nijaay bëgga naa leen,
xoolleen ma tóbal leen ngir yeen rek.
Suma mag suma rakka bëgga naa leen 
xoolleen ma reeyal leen ngir yeen rek.

activities.title: Learning Sounds
activities.content:
Song to Count Words
• Teach the following song:  Song/Rhyme   
• benna ñaar laalal sa bakan, 
• ñette ñenenta tàccul sa loxo,
• juróom juróom benna ripil sa tànka, 
• juróom ñaar, juróom ñétta dajaleel sa óom ,
• juróom ñenent, fukka wengal sa baat.
• Sing 1-2 times.
• Say: Danoo wóyaat wóyu abcd wi, waay bii yoon danu koo wóyee neneen. Baat bu nu wax rek, 
nu rippi sunu tànka yi. Dégluleen bu baax ma won leen defin bu bees bi noo wóyee wóy wi di 
rippiwaale sunu tànka.
• Demonstrate singing and stepping for each word. Then lead pupils in doing the same. Sing 1-2 
more times while stepping for each word.
• Other options: Clap or jump for each word.

activities.title: Alphabet
activities.content:
Name Card 
• Before the lesson, create two name cards for each pupil with their first name.
• Give each pupil their name card and you keep the other set. 
• Say: Na ku nekka, toog fi mu toog. Seetleen tur bi nu binda ci karta bi. Dinaa ékati benna tur ci 
kow, na ku nekka seet ndax méngoo na ak sa bos. Su nekkee sa tur, ñówal ci man. Su nekkul sa 
tur, toogal fi nga nekka.      
• Hold up a name card and walk around so every pupil can see the name. Once there is a match, 
continue with another name. Do as many names as possible in time allotted.

• If pupils are having difficulties, say the name written on the card.

activities.title: Letter of the Week
activities.content:
Learning Letter: "f"
• Write the small letter "f" very big on the board. Point to the letter.
• Say: Lii moo sunu arafu bés bu ay bi. Riiru araf bii moo /f/. Accaleen nu waxandoor ko /f/
• Hold up the letter card. 
• Say: Riir bii moo tàmbali baat bi "fas." /f/ tàmbali baatu " fas"
• Have pupils repeat: " fas ," /f/

activities.title: Writing
activities.content:
Fine Motor Development
• Say: Dina nu tàggat sunu sadditi loxo yi ak yaram. Lii dina nu dimbale nu mën a binda bu baax. 
Ni sunu sadditi loxo yi gën a dégéreee, ci laa gën a yomba nu mën a jéfoo sunu loxo yi sunoo 
binda."     
• Exercise is cross crawling: stand up straight, take one elbow and touch it to the knee on the 
opposite side (raise knee and lower elbow at the same time to meet in the middle); then take 
the other elbow and touch it to the opposite knee.
• Have pupils try for one minute then have them stop and rest for a minute. Then have them try 
again for another minute. 
• If pupils are having difficulty, have them touch one hand to the opposite knee.

lessons.homework:
• Give each pupil a letter card and ask them to practice saying the letter name and 
sound with their family members.
• Ask learners to identify an object from their homes that starts with the letter 
sound of the day and report to class the next day.

activities.title: Comprehension: Before Reading
activities.content:
Making Predictions: Picture Walk
• Say: Mën na noo xool nataal bi, jëfooleen te seet nu léeb bi di mujje. Lii moo di nga leeral lan moo 
war a xew walla nga xelaat ci li nga njorta.
• Read the title of the story. Look at the illustration. Remind the pupils of their predictions. 
• Say: Léegi danoo jànga léeb bi seet ndax li nu njortoon am na.

activities.title: Comprehension: Before Reading
activities.content:
Read Aloud
• Before reading each page, look at the illustration and remind the class what they predicted. 
Then read the page. 
• Say: Ndax li nu njortoon am  na? 
• Provide feedback. Continue through the story.
NATAALU NJABOOT GI
Faatu mu ngi ca waañ wa di déglu waxtaani mag ñi. Nafi ne xaaral ma indi ay nataal, mu indi 
téere nataal bu maget mu ubi ko, ñép di xool nataal yi. Mariyaama ne, "Céy! kii yow la Nafi bi nga 
nekkee xale, waay bii moom ci sa bési takka la woon", nijaay ne," Xoolal! Xoolal! kii moo di sunu 
mag Nuhaa." Noom ñép di xool nataali njaboot gi, Mariyaama joxoñ benna nataal ree, nijaay joxoñ 
beneen nataal ree be kekku ca kow, Nafi moom nekka di xool rek di xelaat. Faatu moom dafa am 
naqar, mu jóg ndànka nadnka dem ca ëttu wallaa ba di jooy.
Mariyaama ne, "Ana Faatu?" Nijaay ne, "Léegi la génna", Nafi ne ko, "xaaral ma seeti ko". Nafi gis 
Faatu, lénga ko, laaj ko "Lan ngaa jooy suma xarit?"
Faatu ñisabu ne ko, "Nekkuma ci benna nataal, ñépangi ci nataal yi be mu des man, Mariyaama 
mungi ci nataal yi, ijaay a ngi ci nataal yi, yow itam yaa ngi ci nataal yi."
Nafi neexal ko, nax ko mu nóppi, Mu wax ko ndànka. "Faatu nataal yii balaa ngaa juddu la woon 
waay jamano jóoju yép mangi àndoon ak yow góm ne dinaa am doom ju jigèen ju rafet be mel ni 
yow te moo yow mii." Nafi wéey ne, "kaay, nanu jél sa nataali xaleyaa yi nu won ko Mariyaama ak 
nijaayam' Faatu mujjée gis nataali xaleyaam ak yeneen nataal yi. Ci nóonu la Faatu gis boppam ci
nataali njaboot gi.

Clap a Rhythm #1
• Say: Dinaa am nu ma tàccoo, léegi dégluleen bu baax.
• Clap the first rhythm (clap 2 times slowly and 3 times quickly). Repeat three times.
• Say: Nanu tàccu mel ni ma ko defewoon.
• Clap the rhythm two more times.
• Say: Léegi dinaa tàccu ni ma ko defewoon ngeen mottali ko.
• Clap 2 times slowly and pupils clap 3 times quickly.
• Repeat with another rhythm. (Rhythm examples: 2 slow-2 fast-2 slow-1 fast; 1 slow-2 fast-1 
slow-2 fast)

activities.content:

• Say: Danoo wóy sunu wóy wi (jànga sunu baat yi) dal di jànga araf yi benna benna

x y)

activities.title: Letter of the Week
activities.content:
Learning Letter "g"
• Write the small letter "g" very big on the board. Point to the letter.
• Say: Bi moo di sunu arafu bés bu ay bi. Riiru araf bii moo /g/. Accaleen nu waxandoor ko /g/.
• Point to the letter on the board or letter card, say the sound, have pupils repeat 3 times 
slowly.
• Write the capital letter "G" very big on the board. Point to the capital letter.
• Say:  Lii benna araf bi la /G/. Moom itam riiru /G/ la. Dina nu ko jéfoo sunoo binda ci tàmbali 
kàddu, turi nit walla béréb.
• Point to the letter on the board or letter card, say the sound, have pupils repeat 3 times 
slowly.
• Point to the small letter "g" on the board or letter card or on the board again.
• Say: Li ci gën a bari nii lanu koo gise  ci baat yi.

activities.title: Writing
activities.content:
Learning Writing Concepts
• Say: Dina nu jànga te jéem ni nu war a binde bu baax. Balaa noo tàmbali danu war a fudda 
sunu loxo yi.
• Warm up exercise: have pupils push their palms together as hard as they can for 10 seconds. 
Then release and shake hands for 10 seconds. Repeat two more times.

• Give each pupil a pencil and demonstrate the proper way to hold a pencil.
 Say: Sunoo binda, danoo tàmbale càmmoñ jém ndeyjoor ak dale ci kow jém ci suuf. Mu mel 
ni soo tiye sa xalimba bi ak di dawale sa loxo jém ci kow. Léegi, nanu jéem a binda dale ci 
càmmoñ jém ci ndeyjoor, te dale ci kow jém ci suuf, mu mel ni, ni nu nu ko defee ci kéyit gi. 
Go through the motions of moving a pencil in the air. Pupils follow you. Have the pupils make 
specific motions like dashes or loops. Look around and make sure pupils are going in the 
proper direction (left to right, then moving down as if moving to a new line).
• Say: Léegi nanu jéem ci sunu taabul yi. Jéfool li ngaay jéfoo ni xalimba te tàmbale binda ca 
kow ci koñi  càmmoñ bi. Dawaleel sa loxo ni ku di binda ci  taabul bi. Soo bindeee ba ca cat la, 
jélal  beneen rédda, tàmbalee ci càmmoñ dem ndeyjoor, wéeyale di binda wàcca ci suuf. 
• Walk around and make sure pupils are demonstrating correct direction of writing. Continue to 
the next line, stopping to check pupil progress before going on.

lessons.homework:
• Ask learners to teach their family members the letter name and sound they learnt today.
• Ask learners to teach proper pencil grip to their family members.

SAMBA AK SEELA
Samba xale bu gòor bu ñenenti at la, ñenenti at la am. Samba dafa amoon benna xaj bu tudda 
Seela am lu nuul ak lu weex ci yaramam. Samba ak Seela ay xarit lanu, te dañu dee defandoor lu 
bari .Benna bés Samba mu ne dafaa tàggat Seela. Mu sànni benna et fu sóri, ne Seela, "Demal 
jélalima et wi". Seela wàncal, daw dem Jéli et wi, indi ko.
Samba wan Seela ab pax bu ndaw. Mu ne Seela,"gasal ma pax mi jàppal ma janax ju fa nekka." 
Seela wàncal tàmbali di gas be jàppa janax ji.
Samba joxoñ ay picca yu nekka di cob ci mboqa mi, mu ne Seela, "jàppal ma si benna pica." Seela 
wàncal daxee picca yi be jàppa si benna picca
Samba joxoñ Kiiki, muus mi dëkka ci kër gi ne, "Seela daxal Kiiki." Seela wàncal tàmbali di daxee 
Kiiki. Kiiki daw. Bi ngoon jotee, njugub yi di naaw ci asamaan si. Samba ñemewul njugub, moo 
jooy. Seela wàncal tàmbali di bow njugub yi. Njugub yi naaw dem. Samba fob Seela neko."Seela

 Say: Su noo binda, danoo binda jóge càmmoñ jém ndeyjoor te dale ci kow jém suuf. Mu mel   
 ni su ngeen tiyee seen xalimba yi di dawale seen loxo jém ci kow. Léegi, nanu jéem a binda   
 dale ci càmmoñ jém ndeyjoor te dale ci kow jém ci suuf, mu mel ni nu koo defe ci kéyit gi.
• Go through the motions of moving a pencil in the air. Pupils follow you. Have the pupils make 
specific motions like dashes or loops. Look around and make sure pupils are going in the 
proper direction (left to right, then moving down as if moving to a new line).

koñi  càmmoñ bi. Dawaleleen seen loxo mel ni ku di binda ci  taabul bi. Soo bindee ba ca cat la, 
jàllal ci beneen rédda bi. Wéey di binda jóge cààmmoñ jém ndeyjoor, jóge ci kow wàcca ci suuf.

activities.title: Vocabulary: During Reading
activities.content:
Read Aloud
• Read the story. While reading, make sure pupils are paying attention and putting their hands 

on their head when a vocabulary word is said. At each vocabulary word, stop and review its 
meaning in the story.
SAMBA AK SEELA
Samba xale bu gòor bu ñenenti at la, Samba dafa amoon benna xaj bu tudda Seela am lu ñuul ak lu 
weex ci yaramam. Samba ak Seela ay xarit lañu, te dañu dee defandoor lu bari. Benna bés
Samba mu ne dafaa tàggat Seela. Mu sànni benna et fu sóri, ne Seela, "demal jélalima et wi". 
Seela wàncal, daw dem Jéli et wi, indi ko.
Samba wan Seela ab pax bu ndaw. Mu ne Seela,"gasal ma pax mi jàppal ma janax ju fa nekka." 
Seela wàncal tàmbali di gas be jàppa janax ji.
Samba joxoñ ay picca yu nekka di cob ci mboqa mi, mu ne Seela, "jàppal ma ci benna pica." Seela 
wàncal daxee picca yi be jàppa ci benna picca
Samba joxoñ Kiiki, muus mi dëkka ci kër gi ne, "Seela daxal Kiiki." Seela wàncal tàmbali di daxee 
Kiiki. Kiiki daw. Bi ngoon jotee, njugub yi di naaw ci asamaan si. Samba ñemewul njugub, mu door 
di jooy.
Seela wàncal di bow njugub yi. Njugub yi naaw dem. Samba fob Seela ne ko. "Seela dëgga dëgga, 
yow mii yaa di suma xarit déggantaan."

activities.title: Writing
activities.content:
Learning Writing Concepts
• Say: Dina nu jànga te jéem ni nu war a binde bu baax. Balaa noo tàmbali danu war a fudda 
sunu loxo yi.
• Warm up exercise: have pupils push their palms together as hard as they can for 10 seconds. 

Then release and shake hands for 10 seconds. Repeat two more times.
• Give each pupil a pencil and demonstrate the proper way to hold a pencil.
• Say:  Su noo binda, danoo tàmbalee càmmoñ jëm ndeyjoor te dale ci kow jëm ci suuf. Tiye leen 
seen xalimba te ékati seen loxo yi. Léegi nanu ko jéem a def tàmbalee ci càmmoñ jém ndeyjoor 
te nekkul jóge ci kow wàcca ci suuf  mu mel nu nu koo defe ci kéyit gi.

specific motions like dashes or loops. Look around and make sure pupils are going in the 
proper direction (left to right, then moving down as if moving to a new line).
• Say: Léegi nanu jéem ci sunu taabul yi. Jéfool lu mel ni xalimba te tàmbale binda ca kow koñi 
càmmoñ bi. Dawaleel sa loxo mel ni ku di binda ci  taabul bi. Soo àggee ca cat la, jélal rédda bi 
ci toppa ci suuf. Wéeyal di binda tambalee càmmoñ dem ndeyjoor, tambalee ci kow wàcca ci 
suuf.
• Walk around and make sure pupils are demonstrating correct direction of writing. Continue to 
• the next line, stopping to check pupil progress before going on.

• Give the pupils a minute to look and think. Call on a pupil at random asking for their answer. 
• Say: Nanu xoolaat nataal bi te wax lan moo war a xew. Lan nga foog ne moo xew ci léeb bi? 
Gómmal te xelaat lan nga foog ne moo war a xew ci léeb bi.

prediction. After the answer, ask why they made the prediction.

activities.content:
Read Aloud
• Read aloud the story. Stop after a few pages/sentences.
• Say: Lan nga foog ne moo war a xew? Gómmal te jéfoo sa xelaat ci lin nga foog ne moo war a 
xew ci léeb bi.
• Call on a pupil at random to give their prediction. Stop 2-3 times during the story.
BINTA DAFA SIBIRU
Binta ak wayjuram yi noo dékka. Wayjuram yi di oote, "Bintaa! Bintaa!" Néeg bi wéet ne tek. 
Binta tontuwuleen. "Ana Binta?" Binta dégga na leen waay uyuwul mungi tédda ci lal bi rek.
Wayjuram yi xoolante, yaayam daw dugga ci néegi Binta ne ko: "Binta jàmma nga fanaan? Naka 
nga def?" Binta ne ko: "Yaay dama feebar." 
Yaayam teg loxoom bi ci jéyu Binta bi ne ko "Sa yaram baa ngi tànga jirr, xaaral ma oo fajkat bi," 
baayam oo fajkat bi ci telefun, fajkat bi ñów seet Binta be sottal ne ko; "Danga sibiru. Dinaa la jox 
garabi sibiru." Biiri Bnta bi di métti, mu laaj fajkat bi ne ko, "Ndax damaa dee?" Fajkat bi ree neko 
"Dèedèet Binta, dinaa la jox garab yu baax be nga wér te di nga nelaw." Yaayam gérém fajkat bi 
neko "jéréjéf." Fajkat bi wax wayjuri Binta ne leen, "Bu leen fàtte di ko jox garabam yi te jòxee 
ko ko ni ma leen ko waxe waay na tédda ci sanke bu am garab ngir aaru ci sibiru." Yaayam xool 
baayam ne ko, "Nanu jéndi sanke bu am garab tey." Binta tédda ci lal bi di leen déglu.

activities.title: Vocabulary: During Reading
activities.content:
Read Aloud
• Read the story. While reading, make sure pupils are paying attention and putting their hands 
on their head when a vocabulary word is said. At each vocabulary word, stop and review its 

meaning in the story.
BINTA DAFA SIBIRU
Binta ak wayjuram yi ñoo dékka. Wayjuram yi di oote, "Bintaa! Bintaa!" Néeg bi wéet ne tek. 
Binta tontuwuleen. "Ana Binta?" Binta dégga na leen waay uyuwul mu ngi tédda ci lal bi rek.
Wayjuram yi xoolante, yaayam daw dugga ci néegi Binta ne ko: "Binta jàmma nga fanaan? Naka 
nga def?" Binta ne ko: "Yaay dama feebar."
Yaayam teg loxoom bi ci jéyu Binta bi ne ko "Sa yaram baa ngi tànga jirr, xaaral ma oo fajkat bi," 
baayam oo fajkat bi ci telefun, fajkat bi ñów seet Binta be sottal ne ko; "Danga sibiru. Dinaa la jox 
garabi sibiru." Biiri Binta bi di métti, mu laaj fajkat bi ne ko, "Ndax damaa dee?" Fajkat bi ree ne 
ko "Dèedèet Binta, di naa la jox garab yu baax be nga wér te di nga nelaw." Yaayam gérém fajkat 
bi ne ko "jëréjëf." Fajkat bi wax wayjuri Binta ne leen, "Bu leen fàtte di ko jox garabam yi te jòxee 
ko ko ni ma leen ko waxe waay na tédda ci sanke bu am garab ngir aaru ci sibiru." Yaayam xool 
baayam ne ko, Nanu jéndi sanke bu am garab tey." Binta tédda ci lal bi di leen déglu.

activities.content:
Clap a Rhythm 
• Say: Dinaa tàccu ci benna anam, kon dégluleen bu baax.
• Clap the first rhythm (clap 2 times slowly and 3 times quickly). Repeat three times.
• Say: Nanu tàccu toppa anam bii.
• Clap the rhythm two more times.
• Say: Léegi dinaa tàmbali yéngu bi, ngeen toppandoor ma.
• Clap 2 times slowly and pupils clap 3 times quickly.
• Repeat with another rhythm. (Rhythm examples: 2 slow-2 fast-2 slow-1 fast; 1 slow-2 fast-1 
slow-2 fast)

activities.title: Letter of the Week
activities.content:
Learning Letter "i"
• Write the small letter "i" very big on the board. Point to the letter.
• Say: "Lii moo di sunu arafu bés bu ay bi. Riiru araf bi moo di /i/. Accaleen nu waxandoor ko 
/i/."
• Point to the letter on the board or letter card, say the sound, have pupils repeat 3 times 
slowly.
• Write the capital letter "I" very big on the board. Point to the capital letter.
• Say: Lii benna araf bi la. Moom itam riiru /I/ la. Dina nu ko jéfoo sunoo binda ci tàmbali kàddu, 
turi nit walla béréb.
• Point to the letter on the board or letter card, say the sound, have pupils repeat 3 times 
slowly.
• Point to the small letter "i" on the board or letter card or on the board again.
• Say: Li ci gën a bari nii lanu koo gise  ci baat yi.

activities.title: Writing
activities.content:
Learning Writing Concepts
• Say: Dina nu jànga te jéem ni nu war a binde bu baax. Balaa noo tàmbali danu war a fudda 
sunu loxo yi.

• Warm up exercise: have pupils push their palms together as hard as they can for 10 seconds. 
Then release and shake hands for 10 seconds. Repeat two more times.
• Give each pupil a pencil and demonstrate the proper way to hold a pencil.
• Say: Su noo binda, danoo tàmbale càmmoñ jém ndeyjoor ak dale ci kow jém ci suuf. Mu mel 
ni soo tiye sa xalimba bi ak di dawale sa loxo jém ci kow. Léegi, nanu jéem a binda dale ci 
càmmoñ jém ci ndeyjoor, te dale ci kow jém ci suuf, mu mel ni, ni nu  ko defe ci kéyit gi.
• Go through the motions of moving a pencil in the air. Pupils follow you. Have the pupils make 
specific motions like dashes or loops. Look around and make sure pupils are going in the 
proper direction (left to right, then moving down as if moving to a new line).
• Say: Léegi nanu jéem ci sunu taabul yi. Jéfool li ngaa jéfoo ni xalimba te tàmbalebinda ca kow 
koñi càmmoñ wa. Dawaleel sa loxo melal ni ku di binda ci taabul bi. Soo binde ba ca cat la, jélal 
beneen rédda bi. Wéey di binda tàmbali càmmoñ dem ndeyjoor, tàmbali ci kow wàcca ci suuf.
• Walk around and make sure pupils are demonstrating correct direction of writing. Continue to 
the next line, stopping to check pupil progress before going on.

activities.title: Comprehension: Before Reading
activities.content:
Making Predictions: Illustration
• Show the illustration. Read the title while pointing to each word. 
• Say: Nanu xool nataal bi. Lan ngeen ci gis?
• Give the pupils a minute to look and think. Call on a pupil at random asking for their answer. 
• Say: Nanu xoolaat nataal bi te njorta lan moo war a xew. Lan nga foog ne moo xew ci léeb bi? 
Gómmal te xelaat lan nga foog ne moo xew ci léeb bi. 
• Give the pupils a minute to look and think. Call on a pupil at random asking for their 
prediction. After the answer, ask why they made the prediction.

activities.title: Comprehension: During Reading
activities.content:
Read Aloud

• Read aloud the story. Stop after a few pages/sentences.
• Say: Xelaat leen lan moo war a xew. Gómmaleen te jéfoo seen xelaat ci li ngeen foog ne moo 
war a xew
• Call on a pupil at random to give their prediction. Stop 2-3 times during the story. 
JÀLLO BËGGULA NELAW 
Jàllo mu ngee fo di wór ci néeg bi ak moto foyeekaayam bi. Bëggula dem téddi nelaw. Yaayam ne 
ko: "Waxtu tédda nelaw jotna." Jàllo faalewul ko, mu wée di fo, di wór ci néeg bi. Yaayam ne ko: 
"Jàllo demal raxas sa gémméñ bi, waxtu tédda jot na." Jàllo faalewul ko, mu wéey di fo di wór ci 
néeg bi. Yaayam ne ko: "Bayyil lingaa  def te ñów tédda." Betey Jàllo faalewul ko, mu wéy di fo, 
di wór ci néeg bi. Yaayam ne ko: "Kaay tédda ma léebal la. Jàllo bàyyi fo mi teg moto foyeekaay bi 
féle, daw dem ci lal bi tédda di xaar léeb bi.
Yaayam tàmbali léeb, ne ko: léeboon.

activities.title: Comprehension: After Reading
activities.content:
Prediction Check
Remind the class what they predicted would happen based on the illustration. Ask the pupils if 
that's what happened? After the response, affirm the correct answer or attempt, let them know if 
it is correct, and clarify the answer.
Factual Questions: Who and What?
• Show the illustration.
• Say: Ban nit walla rab moo feeñ ci léeb bi? (Tontu: Jàllow moo feeñ ci léeb bi).

is correct, and clarify the answer.
• Say: Ñi nekka ci léeb bi def nanu ay jéf. Yii noo di seeni jéf. Lan la ñi nekka ci léeb bi di def ci 
nataal bi?

them know if it is correct, and clarify the answer. 
• Say: Baatu "Lan" dafaa laajte jéf yu ñi gën a fés ci léeb bi di def, walla lan moo war a xew ci 
léeb bi.
• Point to the character's name in the story. Call on a pupil at random to come and point to the 
character in the picture. Find the character's action in the story.

activities.title: Learning Sounds
activities.content:
Clap a Rhythm
• Say: Dinaa tàccu. Ku ci mën a tàccu ni ma ko defe nga ékati sa loxo.
• Start to clap a rhythm. When a pupil puts up their hand, stop and let them try to finish 
clapping the rhythm. If correct, go on to another rhythm. If wrong, have another pupil try. 
Continue 2-3 more times.
• Extension: Have a pupil start a new rhythm for the rest of the class to follow.

activities.title: Alphabet
activities.content:
Alphabet Song
• Say: Dina nu wóy ab wóy wu méngoo ak nu nu war a binde benna benna. Lii dina nu dimbale 
numën a jànga sunu araf yi.
• Sing the alphabet song/chant: /a, b, c/ (a à  b c d e é ë  f h g I j k l  m n ñ ŋ o ó p  q r s t u w x y )

activities.title: Letter of the Week
activities.content:
Learning Letter "j"
• Ban araf lanu jàngoon ci bés bu ay bii? 
• Have the whole class answer.
• Say:  Lan moo di riiri araf bii?
• Have the whole class answer.
• Hold up the alphabet card for the letter. Point to the picture.
• Say: Arafu 'j' bii ban riir la taxawal?
• Have the whole class answer.
• Say: Na ma kenna jox baat bu am riiru /j/.
Call on 2 pupils at random to answer. After the response, affirm the correct answer or   
attempt, let them know if it is correct, and clarify the answer.

lessons.homework:
• Give each pupil a letter card and ask them to practice saying the letter name and sound with 
their family members.
• Ask learners to identify an object from their homes that starts with the letter sound of the day 
and report to class the next day.

learning_outcomes: Listen and identify vocabulary words.
Discuss meaning of vocabulary words.
Begin to understand basic concepts of print.
Identify an action of the character in the story.
Adequately express oneself verbally and nonverbally

activities.title: Vocabulary
activities.content:
Review and Discuss Words
• Words: 
Fajkat   garab
        
• Review the vocabulary words from the first story. Say the first word aloud, and have pupils 
repeat. 
• Say: Gómmaleen te xelaat ab baat. Lan ngeen gis?
• Call on a pupil at random to answer and ask if they remember what the word means. Affirm the 
correct answer or attempt, let them know if it is correct, and clarify the definition. 
• Say: Dinaa jéfoo ab baat ci kàddu. Su ngeen déggee baat bu fés bi ngeen teg seen loxo yi ci seen 
boppa yi.
• Say: Baay gis na fajkat bi tey.
• Talk about ways to act out the word. 
• Say: Baay demoon na gisi fajkat bi démba.
• Say: Léegi danoo defar nataal bu méngoo ak baat bi.
• Talk about how the word can be drawn (object, use, etc.) and draw it on the board.
• Repeat all steps with the next word. For some words, call on a pupil at random to draw the 
picture of the word on the board.

activities.title: Reason to Read
activities.content:
Review Print Concepts
• Think about how we read a book. Show the cover.
• Say: Naka lanoo jàngee téere?
• Call on a pupil at random to come and point to the book: top to bottom and left 
• Say: Naka la nu war a ubbee téere jóge ci benna xët dem ci beneen? 
• Call on a pupil at random to come and point to the book: front to back.

activities.title: Comprehension: Check
activities.content:
Factual Question: Who and What?
• Read the title of the first story this week. 
• Say: Ñan ñoo nekka ci léeb bi? (Tontu: Binta, Baay, yaay, fajkat) 
• Call on a pupil at random to answer.
• Say: Lan la ki nekka ci léeb bi def? Tontu Binta dafa feebar baayam ak yaayam oo fajkat bi mu 
ñów ci kër gi faj Binta. Baayam dem ca teeru ba jéndi sanke. 

• Call on a pupil at random to answer. Affirm the correct answer or attempt, let them know if it 
is correct, and clarify the answer. 
• Have the pupil point to the character in the story. Find the character's action in the story. 
• Have pupils act out the character's action(s) from the story.

lessons.homework: Ask learners to tell their family members about the story that was read in class today.
